### **4.3 Resultat av verfring till TA**

### **Tillfllig tabell fr export till LogTrade** [(Program: Logtrade)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_Logtrade.HTM)

versikt av ordrar verfrda till LogTrade. Programmet visar verfringsdatum och status fr ordrar verfrda till LogTrade.

![NULL](197_LogTrade.gif)

#### Aktuella/viktiga flt/knappar

##### **Identitet** [(Flt:: SQLIDENTITY)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_SQLIDENTITY.HTM)

Numerisk identitet fr aktuell post i databasen. (Fltet erhller sitt vrde automatiskt via SQL Servers IDENTITY-funktion.)  
  

##### **Ordernummer** [(Flt:: OrderNr)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_OrderNr.HTM)

Ordernummer i numeriskt format. Det finns ven ett flt fr alfanumeriska ordernummer.  
  
Vid definition av fretagets ordertyper kan du stta olika nummerserier fr resp. ordertyp. De order vars ordertyp saknar ordernummerserie fr sitt ordernummer frn den hgsta nummerserien.  
  

##### **LeveransID** [(Flt:: OrdLevNr)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_OrdLevNr.HTM)

Leveransnummer inom order. (Planerade delleveranser)
En order kan delas upp i olika leveranser vid orderregistreringstillfllet.  
  

##### **Berknad lev.dag** [(Flt:: OrdBerLevDat)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_OrdBerLevDat.HTM)

Berknad leveransdag till kund.  
  
Om du har angett samma leveransdag p orderhuvud och rader och drefter ndrar leveransdatum p orderhuvudet kommer ven datum p raderna att ndras. Orderrader med annat leveransdatum r huvudet kommer dock inte att pverkas av ndringen.  
  
Frn version 9 finns en parameter (SALES163) med vilken du kan styra att detta flt p orderhuvudet ska uppdateras efter varje delleverans s att fltet alltid visar berknat datum fr nsta leverans.  
  

##### **Restordernr** [(Flt:: OrdRestNr)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_OrdRestNr.HTM)

Fr intern hantering av orderrader med olika leveranstider och/eller lagerstllen skapas s.k. Leveransorder som identifieras m.h.a. restordernumret. Restordernumret r ett lpnummer inom orderradsnumret som automatiskt skapas varje gng en order frislpps fr fakturering och en restnotering uppstr. S hr fungerar numreringen:  
  
 Leveransen tilldelas nytt nummer  
 ---------------------------------------------  
Jeeves skapar en ny orderrad fr den leverans som frislpps fr fakturering, vilken automatiskt fr ett lpnummer (fregende restnummer +1) fr att skapa en unik nyckel fr den nya orderraden.  
  
 Restnoteringen = restordernummer 0  
 -------------------------------------------------  
Den ursprungliga orderraden kvarstr med restordernummer 0 och denna innehller den restleverans som uppstr. En markering grs i fltet Restorder (OrdRestNot) fr att visa att orderraden r restnoterad (denna kan anvndas fr utskning av restnoteringar). Det r alltid utifrn orderrad (restordernummer) 0 som utplock fr leverans och frislppning sker.  
  
De delleveranser som grs fr en orderrad fr allts enligt denna metodik restnummer 1, 2, 3 o.s.v., vilket ocks r den kronologiska ordning i vilken leverans och frislppning fr fakturering har utfrts.  
  
 Omvnd numrering p leveransorderhuvudet  
 ----------------------------------------------------------------  
ven ett leveransorderhuvud skapas automatiskt varje gng en order frislpps fr fakturering och en restnotering uppstr. Det nya leveransorderhuvudet tilldelas ocks ett restordernummer som utgr ett lpnummer inom det ursprungliga ordernumret (fregende restnummer +1) fr att skapa en unik nyckel till det nya leveransorderhuvudet. Hr r det omvnt mot funktionen p orderraden, vilket innebr att den restleverans som uppstr vid frislppning fr fakturering fr det hgsta restordernumret.  
  
Det finns sledes ingen relation mellan de restordernummer som skapas p orderrad och leveransorderhuvud.  
  

##### **Status** [(Flt:: LogtradeStatus)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_LogtradeStatus.HTM)

Status fr verfring till Logtrade.  
  
verfringen innehller nya, o-verfrda poster och poster med status 10, 20, -1, 70, 71 och 80.  







| Status (LogtradeStatus) | Status beskr (LogtradeStatusDescr) | Beskrivning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 10 | Ny | Status innan verfring till Logtrade. |
| 20 | Pgende verfring | Status under verfring till LogTrade. |
| 30 | verfring avslutad | Normal status. |
| 31 | Sparad | verfrd data kan inte valideras av LogTrade. |
| 32 | Frislppt | Ej tillmpligt |
| 33 | Validerad | Ej tillmpligt |
| 70 | Generellt DB fel | Felhantering. Databasfel loggat till fil. |
| 71 | Omfrsk att ansluta till DB | Felhantering. Databasfel loggat till fil. |
| 80 | Omfrsk att verfra | Koppling till LogTrade misslyckades. Tjnsten kommer att frska igen tills verfringen lyckas. |
| 98 | WebService datafel | Koppling till LogTrade misslyckades. Tjnsten kommer att frska igen tills verfringen lyckas. |
| 99 | verfrt med fel | Fel rapporterat frn LogTrade, verfrd data felaktig (Misslyckades). |
| -1 | Avstngd | Tjnsten r avstngd. Till exempel felaktigt lsenord till LogTrade. |

Detta kapitel beskriver hur du stller in funktionen fr omsttningsskatt fr USA och Kanada, och hur den fungerar.  

1 Kontrollera/stt fljande systemuppgifter och parametrar
--------------------------------------------------------

### **1.1 stt fljande parameter till Y**

### **Applikationsparametrar** [(Program: jvsp)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_jvsp.HTM)

#### Aktuella/viktiga flt/knappar

##### **Parameternamn** [(Flt:: jeevesparamname)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_jeevesparamname.HTM)

  

JeevesParamName = **SALES245**  

Denna parameter kan anvndas fr vlja om speciell funktionalitet avseende hantering av omsttningsskatt (Sales Tax) fr USA/Canada skall
vara aktiv eller ej i systemet.  
  
Parameter P:  
===========  
Speciell funktionalitet avseende hantering av omsttningsskatt (Sales Tax) fr USA/Canada r AKTIV i systemet.  
Omsttningsskatt mste sttas upp fr minst 1 skatteniv, d.v.s. State/PST.  
  
Parameter AV (Default):  
==================  
Speciell funktionalitet avseende hantering av omsttningskatt (Sales Tax) fr USA/Canada r EJ AKTIV i systemet.  
  
Kategorisering: JvspTax

2 Fyll i basuppgifter
---------------------

### **2.1 Stll in tillmpliga skatteomrden**

### **Skatteomrdesniver 1-5** [(Program: taxarealevels)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_taxarealevels.HTM)

Definition av omsttningsskatteomrden fr alla omsttningsskatteniver (1-5).  
  
Det finns ocks separata program fr varje omsttningsskatteniv, om du skulle vilja definiera eller underhlla skatteomrden fr en specifik niv i taget.
  
Flten som beskrivs nedan hnfr sig till niv 1, State/PST. Du finner motsvarande flt p varje niv.  

![NULL](198_taxarealevels.gif)

#### Aktuella/viktiga flt/knappar

##### **Skatteomrdesniv 1** [(Flt:: taxareacode1)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_taxareacode1.HTM)

ID fr omsttningsskatteomrde niv 1, d.v.s. delstat (State eller PST).  
  
Du mste registrera en delstat (State/PST) frst, innan du kan registrera ett Ln (County/GST) och drefter en ort (City/HST).  
  

##### **Skatteomrdesniv 1** [(Flt:: taxareadescr1)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_taxareadescr1.HTM)

Namn p frsljningsskatteomrde niv 1, d.v.s namn p State eller Provincial Sales Tax (PST).  
Refererar till funktionalitet avseende USA/Kanada frsljningsskatt.  
  

##### **Skatteomrdessats 1** [(Flt:: taxarearate1)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_taxarearate1.HTM)

Skattesats i procent fr frsljningsskatteomrde niv 1, d.v.s. State eller Provincial Sales Tax (PST).  
Refererar till funktionalitet avseende USA/Kanada frsljningsskatt.  
  

### **2.2 Landsspecifika flt fr Kanada**

#### Aktuella/viktiga flt/knappar

##### **Berkning av skattekedja 1** [(Flt:: taxchaincalc1)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_taxchaincalc1.HTM)

Detta flt r endast tillmplig p vissa omsttningsskatteomrden i Kanada. Om markerad (eller Y) p   
  
niv 1 (PST) kommer detta att rvas till niv 2 (GST).   
  
Fr vidare information, se hjlptexten fr flten Berkning av skattekedja 2-5.  
  

##### **Berkning av skattekedja 2** [(Flt:: taxchaincalc2)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_taxchaincalc2.HTM)

Detta flt r endast tillmplig p vissa omsttningsskatteomrden i Kanada.   
  
 - Om markerat (eller Y), kommer den federala GST-skattesatsen att tillmpas ovanp PST-skattesatsen, en   
  
s kallad kedjeberkning.   
  
 - Om omarkerat (eller N) kommer den federala GST-skattesatsen att lggas till PST-skattesatsen.  
  

##### **Berkning av skattekedja 3** [(Flt:: taxchaincalc3)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_taxchaincalc3.HTM)

Detta flt r endast tillmplig p vissa omsttningsskatteomrden i Kanada.   
  
 - Om markerat (eller Y), kommer HST-skattesatsen att tillmpas ovanp GST-skattesatsen, en s kallad   
  
kedjeberkning.   
  
 - Om omarkerat (eller N) kommer HST-skattesatsen att lggas till GST-skattesatsen.  
  

##### **Berkning av skattekedja 4** [(Flt:: taxchaincalc4)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_taxchaincalc4.HTM)

Detta flt r endast tillmplig p vissa omsttningsskatteomrden i Kanada.   
  
 - Om markerat (eller Y), kommer skattesatsen p niv 4 att tillmpas ovanp skattesatsen p niv 3, en s   
  
kallad kedjeberkning.   
  
 - Om omarkerat (eller N) kommer skattesatsen p niv 4 att lggas till skattesatsen p niv 3.  
  

##### **Berkning av skattekedja 5** [(Flt:: taxchaincalc5)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_taxchaincalc5.HTM)

Detta flt r endast tillmplig p vissa omsttningsskatteomrden i Kanada.   
  
 - Om markerat (eller Y), kommer skattesatsen p niv 5 att tillmpas ovanp skattesatsen p niv 4, en s   
  
kallad kedjeberkning.   
  
 - Om omarkerat (eller N) kommer skattesatsen p niv 5 att lggas till skattesatsen p niv 4.  
  

### **2.3 Definiera skatteomrden i fretagstabellen**

### **Fretag** [(Program: fr)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_fr.HTM)

I USA och Kanada r det leveransadressen, i Jeeves Leveransplatserna (lp), eller om den saknas, kunden, som bestmmer omsttningsskatten (i motsats till betalaren, nr det gller moms). Leveranspunkterna och kunderna mste definieras i fretagstabellen (fr), och drfr har omsttningsskattens omrdeskoder lagts till i fretagstabellen.  

#### Aktuella/viktiga flt/knappar

##### **Skatteomrdesniv 1** [(Flt:: TaxAreaCode1)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_TaxAreaCode1.HTM)

ID fr omsttningsskatteomrde niv 1, d.v.s. delstat (State eller PST).  
  
Du mste registrera en delstat (State/PST) frst, innan du kan registrera ett Ln (County/GST) och drefter en ort (City/HST).  
  

##### **Skatteomrdesniv 2** [(Flt:: TaxAreaCode2)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_TaxAreaCode2.HTM)

ID fr omsttningsskatteomrde niv 2, d.v.s. ln (County eller GST).  
  
Du mste registrera en delstat (State/PST) frst, innan du kan registrera ett Ln (County/GST) och drefter en ort (City/HST).  
  

##### **Skatteomrdesniv 3** [(Flt:: TaxAreaCode3)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_TaxAreaCode3.HTM)

ID fr omsttningsskatteomrde niv 3, d.v.s. ort (City eller HST).  
  
Du mste registrera en delstat (State/PST) frst, innan du kan registrera ett Ln (County/GST) och drefter en ort (City/HST).  
  

##### **Skatteomrdesniv 4** [(Flt:: TaxAreaCode4)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_TaxAreaCode4.HTM)

ID fr omsttningsskatteomrde niv 4, d.v.s. lokalt ln (Local county).  
  
Du mste registrera en delstat (State/PST) frst, innan du kan registrera ett Ln (County/GST) och drefter en ort (City/HST).  
  

##### **Skatteomrdesniv 5** [(Flt:: TaxAreaCode5)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_TaxAreaCode5.HTM)

ID fr omsttningsskatteomrde niv 5, d.v.s. lokal ort (Local City).  
  
Du mste registrera en delstat (State/PST) frst, innan du kan registrera ett Ln (County/GST) och drefter en ort (City/HST).  
  

### **2.4 Definiera momstyper**

### **Momssatser** [(Program: xx1)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_xx1.HTM)

Definition av de momskoder som anvnds vid frsljning och inkp, med tillhrande lagstadgade momssatser. Momskoderna kan ven anvndas fr att, via konteringsmallar, styra frsljningskonteringar.  
  
 Omsttningsskatt (USA och Kanada)  
 --------------------------------------------------------  
Du mste definiera minst en momskod fr normal skatt och en fr skattebefrielse, men med 0 % skattesats (skattesatser definieras p omsttningsskatten, skatteomrden niv 1-5). Du kan definiera den frvalda momskoden i systemfilen (sy1) och/eller definiera momskoder per kund, leveransplats och artikel.  
  
Om du tnker anvnda olika redovisningskonton fr de olika skatteomrdena, till exempel en per stat/PST (geografiska skatteomrden i USA/Kanada), mste du definiera en momskod per skatteomrde. Om vissa artiklar inte r skattepliktiga mste du definiera momskoder fr bde normal skatt och skattebefrielse, liksom per skatteomrde.

![NULL](17_xx1.gif)

#### Aktuella/viktiga flt/knappar

##### **Omsttningsskatt** [(Flt:: SalesTaxHandling)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_SalesTaxHandling.HTM)

Om markerad (eller Y) r omsttningsskatt tillmplig p momstypen, kunden, ordern eller fakturan i frga. Detta innebr att momsen inte r tillmplig, ven om du rkar skriva in en momssats fr momstypen (x1.momssats) av misstag.  
  

##### **Omsttningsskattekod** [(Flt:: Taxcodedescr)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_Taxcodedescr.HTM)







| Omsttningsskattekod (Taxcodedescr) | Omsttningsskattekod (TaxCodeDescr) | Beskrivning |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 0 | Befriad | Kunden r befriad frn omsttningsskatt i denna delstat, detta ln eller denna ort. |
| 1 | Normal skatt | Omsttningsskatt pfrs kunden enligt skattesatserna som definierats per delstat, ln eller ort. |

### **2.5 Koppla leveransplatser till momskoder**

### **Leveransplats hos kund** [(Program: lp)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_lp.HTM)

#### Aktuella/viktiga flt/knappar

##### **Momskod** [(Flt:: momskod)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_momskod.HTM)

Stll in relevant momskod p varje leveransplats, normal skatt eller skattebefrielse, eller per stat/PST, enligt beskrivningen ovan.  
  

### **2.6 Koppla, vid behov, kunder till momskoder**

### **Kunder** [(Program: kus)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_kus.HTM)

#### Aktuella/viktiga flt/knappar

##### **Momskod** [(Flt:: momskod)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_momskod.HTM)

Definiera om s nskas, relevant momskod p kunder, normal skatt eller skattebefrielse.  
  

### **2.7 Koppla, vid behov, artiklar till momskoder**

### **Artiklar** [(Program: artikel)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_artikel.HTM)

#### Aktuella/viktiga flt/knappar

##### **Momskod** [(Flt:: momskod)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_momskod.HTM)

Stll om s nskas in relevant momskod p artiklar, normal skatt eller skattebefrielse.  
  

### **2.8 Registrera eventuell skattebefrielse per skatteomrde och artikel**

### **Omsttningsskatt, undantag, artikel** [(Program: taxexemptar)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_taxexemptar.HTM)

Definition av undantag frn omsttningsskatt per artikel. Programmet kan ns frn menyn eller via en programnod i programmet Artiklar (artikel).  
  
Exempel: En viss artikel skulle kunna vara befriad frn skatt i ett visst ln (county) under en viss period beroende p ssongsmssiga vdersituationer. D stller du in skattenivn 0% fr artikeln och lnet, och specificerar datumintervallet fr undantaget.

![NULL](198_taxexemptar.gif)

### **2.9 Registrera eventuell skattebefrielse per skatteomrde och artikelgrupp**

### **Omsttningsskatt, undantag, artikelgrupp** [(Program: taxexemptvg)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_taxexemptvg.HTM)

Definition av undantag frn omsttningsskatt per artikelgrupp. Programmet kan ns frn menyn eller via en programnod i programmet Varugrupper (vg).  
  
Exempel: En viss artikel skulle kunna vara befriad frn skatt i ett visst ln (county) under en viss period beroende p ssongsmssiga vdersituationer. D stller du in skattenivn 0% fr artikelgruppen och lnet, och specificerar datumintervallet fr undantaget.

### **2.10 Registrera vid behov befrielsecertifikat**

### **Fretag** [(Program: fr)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_fr.HTM)

Om ett fretag har ett skattebefrielsecertifikat, kan du registrera certifikatet med information om dess nummer, skatteomrde och giltighet i en underliggande nod p fretaget. Detta anvnds endast fr informationsndaml, det finns ingen logik kopplad till informationen.

3 Beskrivning av momsfunktionen
-------------------------------

### **3.1 Ordrar**

Nr du registrerar en order hmtas omsttningsskatten frn skatteomrdesniv(er) p fretaget, under frutsttning att kunden eller artikeln inte r undantagen frn omsttningsskatt.  
  
Om du registrerar en avvikande leveransplats i orderhuvudet, kommer omsttningsskatten att hmtas frn skatteomrdesniv(er) p leveransplatsen. Om du registrerar en manuell leveransadress i orderrubriken, mste du ocks registrera omsttningsskatteniv(er) manuellt.  
  
Det finns ett inbddat fnster fr pfrd omsttningsskatt i orderrubriken, som visar omsttningsskattetotaler per omrde och skattesats. I illustrationen nedan har vi placerat detta fnster nedanfr orderradsfnstret.  

![NULL](198_order1.gif)
Det finns ocks en underliggande nod p orderraderna, dr du kan se omsttningsskattedetaljer per orderrad.  

### **Orderbekrftelse**

Det finns ett speciellt rapportfnster (rVOhSalesTax) som du kommer att behva gra synligt om du vill skriva ut omsttninsskattedetaljerna p orderbekrftelser.  

### **3.2 Fakturering**

### **Kundfakturor** [(Program: fh)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_fh.HTM)

Innan fakturering finns det ett speciellt rapportfnster (rVOhSalesTax) som du kommer att behva gra synligt om du vill skriva ut omsttninsskattedetaljerna p fakturor.  
  
Det finns ocks motsvarande inbddade fnster fr pfrda omsttningsskatter p fakturarubriken och fakturaraderna, som det som visas ovan.

4 Ytterligare basdata fr punktskatt
-----------------------------------

### **4.1 Definiera tillmpliga punktskattesatser**

### **Punktsskatt** [(Program: excisetax)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_excisetax.HTM)

Definition av tillmpliga punktskatter (USA, Kanada) och hur dessa ska berknas.

![NULL](198_excisetax.gif)

#### Aktuella/viktiga flt/knappar

##### **Punktskatt** [(Flt:: ExciseTaxCode)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_ExciseTaxCode.HTM)

Numeriskt ID fr punktskatt.  
  

##### **Punktskatt** [(Flt:: ExciseTaxDescr)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_ExciseTaxDescr.HTM)

Beskrivning fr den aktuella punktsskattetypen.  
  

##### **Punktskatt rntesats** [(Flt:: ExciseTaxRate)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_ExciseTaxRate.HTM)

Rntesats fr punktskatt i procent. Om punktskatt ska berknas p nettobeloppet eller belopp inkluderat skatter styrs av kryssrutan Skatter inkluderat (ExciseTaxOnTopSalesTax).  
  

##### **Skatter inkluderat** [(Flt:: ExciseTaxOnTopSalesTax)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_ExciseTaxOnTopSalesTax.HTM)

Om ikryssat (sant) berknas punktskatt baserat p pris inklusive skatter (USA och Kanada).  
  
Ja (sant) - Punktskatt berknas p bruttobeloppet/inklusive skatter.
Nej (falskt) - Punktskatt berknas p nettobeloppet.

### **Artiklar** [(Program: artikel)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_artikel.HTM)

Beskrivning fr den aktuella punktsskattetypen.  
  

### **4.3 Aktivera punktskattshantering fr relevanta kunder**

### **Kunder** [(Program: kus)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_kus.HTM)

### **4.4 Lgg till detalj fr konteringsmall**

### **4.5 Lgg till flt i fakturamall**

Du mste lgga till flten i relevanta fakturamallar i fnstret Momssatser p kundfaktura.  

#### Aktuella/viktiga flt/knappar

##### **Punktskatt rntesats** [(Flt:: excisetaxrate)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_excisetaxrate.HTM)

Rntesats fr punktskatt i procent. Om punktskatt ska berknas p nettobeloppet eller belopp inkluderat skatter styrs av kryssrutan Skatter inkluderat (ExciseTaxOnTopSalesTax).  
  

##### **Punktskatt** [(Flt:: excisetaxamount)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_excisetaxamount.HTM)

Belopp i basvaluta per faktuarad fr punktskatt.

5 Beskrivning av punktskattsfunktionen
--------------------------------------

Nr du registrerar en order berknas punktskatten enligt angiven procentsats av nettobeloppet eller beloppet inklusive moms. Det styrs av kryssrutan Skatter inkluderat (ExciseTaxOnTopSalesTax) i punktskattsprogrammet (excisetax). Resulterande punktskatt visas i samma inbddade lista som momsen, enligt exemplet nedan.  
  
Nr du fakturerar ordern visas samma information i en motsvarande lista i fakturaformulret.  

![NULL](198_order1_excise.gif)

                [3.2 Fakturera order](#section3.2)  
                NULL
                NULL

  

Frn JAS version 12 kan du fakturera pminnelseavgifter och rnta i samband med normal fakturering av order i frsljningsmodulen, i stllet fr i en separat rutin i kundreskontran. Detta r ett vanligt arbetsstt i till exempel Norge.   
  
Observera att detta gller bde normal fakturering och samfakturering, men bara i frsljningsmodulen.  
  
Detta kapitel beskriver kortfattat hur du stller in funktionen, och hur den fungerar. Funktionen r baserad p Jeeves standardfunktionalitet fr fakturakostnader, som beskrivs i kapitlet (om du lser online, klicka p lnken nedan):  

### [**Fakturakostnader (orderavslut)**](ms-its:DocAreas_SE.chm::/doc_120.HTM)

1 Kontrollera/stt fljande systemuppgifter och parametrar
--------------------------------------------------------

### **1.1 Stll in denna parameter till 1, 2 eller 3**

### **Applikationsparametrar** [(Program: jvsp)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_jvsp.HTM)

#### Aktuella/viktiga flt/knappar

##### **Parameternamn** [(Flt:: jeevesparamname)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_jeevesparamname.HTM)

  

JeevesParamName = **ACCREC030**  

Parameter fr att ange om rnta och/eller pminnelseavgifter faktureras p frsljningsordrar.  
  
 1 = endast rnta  
 2 = bde rnta och pminnelseavgifter   
 3 = endast pminnelseavgifter  
  
Obs! Om du stter vrdet fr denna parameter till 1 eller 2, kan du sidostta Jeeves standardfunktioner fr rntefakturering i Kundreskontran.  
  
Om parametern r instlld p 0 (eller NULL) faktureras varken rnta eller pminnelseavgifter p frsljningsordrar, dvs. pminnelser och rntefakturering hanteras i en separat rutin i Kundreskontran.  
  
Kategorisering: JvspIntrst, JvspRemind  
  

### 1.2 **Fakturakostnadstyper, fsg** [(Program: xxfks)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_xxfks.HTM)

Fakturakostnadstyp 300 och/eller 301 anvnds fr detta ndaml.  

#### Aktuella/viktiga flt/knappar

##### **Fakt.kostn.typ** [(Flt:: FaktKostnTyp)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_FaktKostnTyp.HTM)







| Fakt.kostn.typ (FaktKostnTyp) | Fakt.kostn.typ (FaktKostnTypBeskr) |
| --- | --- |
| 1 | Emballage |
| 2 | Frskring |
| 3 | Frakt |
| 4 | Expeditionsavgift |
| 5 | vrig fakturakostnad-1 |
| 6 | vrig fakturakostnad-2 |
| 10 | Frskott |
| 101 | vrig faktureringsavgift-1 |
| 102 | vrig faktureringsavgift-2 |
| 103 | vrig faktureringsavgift-3 |
| 104 | vrig faktureringsavgift-4 |
| 105 | vrig faktureringsavgift-5 |
| 106 | vrig faktureringsavgift-6 |
| 107 | vrig faktureringsavgift-7 |
| 108 | vrig faktureringsavgift-8 |
| 109 | vrig faktureringsavgift-9 |
| 110 | vrig faktureringsavgift-10 |
| 200 | Prisdifferens Paket och detaljer |
| 300 | Rnta |
| 301 | Pminnelseavgift |

2 Fyll i basuppgifter
---------------------

### **2.1 Registrera kostnaden som en artikel**

### **Artiklar** [(Program: artikel)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_artikel.HTM)

Definiera pminnelseavgiften och/eller rntan som artiklar i artikeltabellen. Du styr konteringen av fakturakostnaden via dess produktkonto.  

### **2.2 Koppla fakturakostnad till artikeln**

### **Fakturakostnader** [(Program: xfkst)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_xfkst.HTM)

Definition av kostnader fr frakt, emballage, frskring och expeditionsavgift fr utskrift p kundfakturor. Det finns ett antal "vriga" kostnadstyper du kan anvnda efter eget nskeml. Observera att kostnadstyperna 100 och hgre mste aktiveras med styrparametern SALES173.  
  
Definitionen gr ut p att  
 knyta typ av fakturakostnad frn dropplistan (vars innehll vi har definierat i programmet Fakturakostnadstyper, fsg (xxfks)) med den artikel i artikeltabellen p vilken kostnaden har definierats, samt  
 ange om respektive kostnad ska skrivas ut som separata detaljrader p fakturan eller redovisas i fakturafoten.  
  
Sjlva beloppet anger du manuellt i orderavslutsbilden. P detta stt slipper du registrera den hr typen av kostnader som separata orderrader.  
  
 Momshantering fr frakt  
 \_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_  
  
Normalt sett br du inte ange ngon momskod p fakturaavgifter. Detta innebr att alla fraktkostnader har samma momssats. Den stts enligt standardreglerna vid orderregistrering, det vill sga att om det finns en momskod p artikeln s anvnds den s lnge som fakturans momskod har en sats <> 0.  
  
I de fall fraktkostnaden avser frsljning av artiklar med olika momssatser, t.ex. bcker (6 %) och musik-CD-skivor (25 %), ska beskattningsunderlaget fr fraktkostnaden frdelas p beskattningsunderlaget fr respektive artikel. Den del av fraktkostnaden som avser frsljningen av bckerna beskattas allts med 6% och den del som avser frsljningen av CD-skivorna beskattas med 25%.  
  
Fr att ovanstende exempel ska fungera mste du registrera frakt som en kostnad tv gnger i denna tabell och knyta den ena definitionen till momskod 6% och den andra till momskod 25%.  
  
Om fraktkostnader skrivs ut som separata fakturarader och du vill att momssatsen ska framg p raden, kan du antingen lgga till fakturaradens momssats p fakturamallen (men d kommer uppgiften att skrivas ut ven fr vanliga artikelrader) eller s kan du lgga upp flera artiklar fr frakt med momssatsen i artikelbenmningen.

3 Arbetsflde
------------

### **3.1 Kr betalningspminnelser och rntefakturering**

Du skapar pminnelser och/eller rntefakturor, med jmna mellanrum p normalt stt i kundreskontran, **men utan att skriva ut dem.** Instllningar och arbetsflde beskrivs i kapitlet (vid lsning online, klicka p lnken nedan):  

### [**Krav**](ms-its:DocAreas_SE.chm::/doc_153.HTM)

### [**Rntefakturering**](ms-its:DocAreas_SE.chm::/doc_156.HTM)

### **3.2 Fakturera order**

Fakturera ordern p normalt stt, i ngot av order-/plocknings-/faktureringsprogrammen i frsljningsmodulen. Nr du fakturerar order kontrollerar Jeeves, om det finns ngon pminnelseavgift och/eller rnta fr kunden i frga. Om det r s lggs automatiskt orderrader till fr detta.  
  
Instllning och arbetsflde beskrivs i kapitlet (vid lsning online, klicka p lnken nedan):  

### [**Fakturera order**](ms-its:DocAreas_SE.chm::/doc_113.HTM)

### **1.16 GetDevice**

Function GetDevice; (currently specific to the Mobile client)  
  
Returns a Device object (ZDeviceObject).  
  
Following is an example of the GetDevice macro:  
  
function MobileObject: boolean;
var  
 mObj: Object;  
 iCount: Integer;  
 iNum: Integer;
begin  
  
mObj:= Application.getDevice;  
 if mObj<>0 then  
 begin  
 Message('mobile');  
 iCount:= mObj.GetNoParams;   
 Message('params ' + iCount);  
 mObj.SendSMS('sMobileNumber','msg');  
 Message('Hello');  
 iNum:= 0;  
 while iNum< iCount do  
 begin  
 Message(mObj.GetTypeOfParam(iNum) + ' '+ mObj.GetValueOfParam(iNum));  
 iNum:= iNum+1;  
 end;  
 Message('getnotificationid ' + mObj.getnotificationid);  
 Message('getdeviceid ' + mObj.getdeviceid);  
 Message('getdevicetype ' + mObj.getdevicetype);  
 Message('getdevicesubtype ' + mObj.getdevicesubtype);  
 Message('getdeviceos ' + mObj.getdeviceos);  
 Message('getdevicelanguage ' + mObj.getdevicelanguage);  
 Message('getdevicetimezone ' + mObj.getdevicetimezone);  
  
mObj.SendSMS('sMobileNumber','msg');  
   
 mObj.SendEmail('EmailAddress ', 'subject', 'msg');  
   
 //last parameter true means silent mode (does not ask for confirmation)  
 mObj.ScheduleAppointment('2016-5-14 11:45', '2016-5-21 13:20', 2, 'UI schedule', 'msg', false);   
 mObj.ScheduleAppointment('2016-5-13 10:45', '2016-5-20 11:00', 2, 'silentschedule', 'msg', true);  
 mObj.AddContact('silent firstName', 'lastName', 'email', 'phone', true);  
 mObj.AddContact('ui firstName', 'lastName', 'email', 'phone', flase);  
   
 //open addressbook  
 mObj.GetContact;  
   
 //Open calendar for the day specified  
 mObj.OpenCalendar('2016-1-22');  
  
end;

### **1.19 MessageBox**

function MessageBox( sText: string; sCaption: string; iType: Integer ): Integer;  
  
Presents a message box to the user with the specified text and caption. The iType parameter can be a combination of the below constants. Returns the result code for the button pressed.  
  
ID\_OK = 1 OK button was selected.
ID\_CANCEL = 2 Cancel button was selected.
ID\_ABORT = 3 Abort button was selected.
ID\_RETRY = 4 Retry button was selected.
ID\_IGNORE = 5 Ignore button was selected.
ID\_YES = 6 Yes button was selected.
ID\_NO = 7 No button was selected.
ID\_TRYAGAIN = 10 Try Again button was selected.
ID\_CONTINUE = 11 Continue button was selected.   
  
MB\_OK = 0 The message box contains one push button: OK. This is the default.  
MB\_OKCANCEL = 1 The message box contains two push buttons: OK and Cancel.  
MB\_ABORTRETRYIGNORE = 2 The message box contains three push buttons: Abort, Retry, and Ignore.  
MB\_YESNOCANCEL = 3 The message box contains three push buttons: Yes, No, and Cancel.  
MB\_YESNO = 4 The message box contains two push buttons: Yes and No.  
MB\_RETRYCANCEL = 5 The message box contains two push buttons: Retry and Cancel.  
  
MB\_ICONSTOP = 16 A stop-sign icon appears in the message box.  
MB\_ICONERROR = 16 A stop-sign icon appears in the message box.  
MB\_ICONHAND = 16 A stop-sign icon appears in the message box.  
MB\_ICONQUESTION = 32 A question-mark icon appears in the message box. The question-mark message icon is no longer recommended because it does not clearly represent a specific type of message and because the phrasing of a message as a question could apply to any message type. In addition, users can confuse the message symbol question mark with Help information. Therefore, do not use this question mark message symbol in your message boxes. The system continues to support its inclusion only for backward compatibility.  
MB\_ICONEXCLAMATION = 48 An exclamation-point icon appears in the message box.  
MB\_ICONWARNING = 48 An exclamation-point icon appears in the message box.  
MB\_ICONINFORMATION = 64 An icon consisting of a lowercase letter i in a circle appears in the message box.  
MB\_ICONASTERISK = 64 An icon consisting of a lowercase letter i in a circle appears in the message box.  
  
MB\_DEFBUTTON1 = 0 The first button is the default button.
MB\_DEFBUTTON2 = 256 The second button is the default button.  
MB\_DEFBUTTON3 = 512 The third button is the default button.  
MB\_DEFBUTTON4 = 768 The fourth button is the default button.  
MB\_APPLMODAL = 0 The user must respond to the message box before continuing work in the window identified by the hWnd parameter. However, the user can move to the windows of other threads and work in those windows. Depending on the hierarchy of windows in the application, the user may be able to move to other windows within the thread. All child windows of the parent of the message box are automatically disabled, but pop-up windows are not. MB\_APPLMODAL is the default if neither MB\_SYSTEMMODAL nor MB\_TASKMODAL is specified.  
MB\_SYSTEMMODAL = 4096 Same as MB\_APPLMODAL except that the message box has the WS\_EX\_TOPMOST style. Use system-modal message boxes to notify the user of serious, potentially damaging errors that require immediate attention (for example, running out of memory). This flag has no effect on the user's ability to interact with windows other than those associated with hWnd.  
MB\_TASKMODAL = 8192 Same as MB\_APPLMODAL except that all the top-level windows belonging to the current thread are disabled if the hWnd parameter is NULL. Use this flag when the calling application or library does not have a window handle available but still needs to prevent input to other windows in the calling thread without suspending other threads. To specify other options, use one or more of the following values.  
MB\_HELP = 16384 Windows 95/98/Me, Windows NT 4.0 and later: Adds a Help button to the message box. When the user clicks the Help button or presses F1, the system sends a WM\_HELP message to the owner.  
MB\_NOFOCUS = 32768
MB\_SETFOREGROUND = 65536
MB\_DEFAULT\_DESKTOP\_ONLY = 131072
MB\_TOPMOST = 262144
MB\_RIGHT = 524288
MB\_RTLREADING = 1048576

### **1.21 OleVariantMissing**

function OleVariantMissing : Object  
  
OleVariantMissing of object Application is available from kernel 3.5.  
  
Creates a ComMissingObject with a variant object having empty value.   
  
function sample : boolean;
var  
 oExcel, oWorkBooks, oWorkBook, oSheets, oSheet1, oSheet2, oMissing, oAfter : object;  
 bDisplayAlerts : boolean;  
 nCount : Integer;
begin  
 // Create an instance of an Excel object on the client-side  
 oExcel := Application.CreateComObject('Excel.Application', True);  
 // Make Excel visible  
 oExcel.Visible := True;  
 bDisplayAlerts := oExcel.DisplayAlerts;  
 // Identify the Workbooks collection in Excel  
 oWorkBooks := oExcel.WorkBooks;  
 // Add a workbook  
 oWorkBook := oWorkBooks.Add;  
 oSheets := oWorkBook.Sheets;  
 nCount := oSheets.Count;  
 // get the last sheet by index  
 oAfter := oSheets.Item(nCount);  
 // Name the sheet so we can identify it  
 oAfter.Name := 'existing';  
 // get a variant of type VT\_ERROR with value DISP\_E\_PARAMNOTFOUND so we can 'skip' parameters instead of oSheets.Add( , oAfter); or oSheets.Add(After:=oAfter); which JML doesnt support  
 oMissing := Application.OleVariantMissing;  
 oSheet1 := oSheets.Add(oMissing, oAfter);  
 // Name the sheet so we can identify it  
 oSheet1.Name := 'last';  
 oSheet2 := oSheets.Add(oAfter);  
 // Name the sheet so we can identify it  
 oSheet2.Name := 'first';  
 oMissing := 0;  
 oSheet1 := 0;  
 oSheet2 := 0;  
 oAfter := 0;  
 oSheets := 0;  
 oWorkBook := 0;  
 oWorkBooks := 0;  
 oExcel := 0;
end;
  

### **1.22 GetRestClient**

Function GetRestClient(Friendly name: string, JSB-Url: string): object;  
  
Function to return REST client objects.   
  
This function accepts two parameters:   
 - A unique name for the instance of the REST client, which can be referred for further calls to REST service. Note that the name is not mandatory as the function works even if an empty string is passed  
 - The base URL of the service. The URL should point to a restful service, for example to call JSB to send a notification, the URL is https://notify.jeeves.se:9000/jsb-url/  
  
Example: *Calls JSB to send a notification to a client device and returns a message of success or failure.*  
 ...  
  
Client:=Application.GetRESTClient( 'NotifyAllRESTclient', 'https://notify.jeeves.se:9000/jsb-url/');  
 Client.CreateBasicAuthenticator( 'jsb', '123' );  
 Client.SetContentType( 'application/x-www-form-urlencoded ; charset=UTF-8' );  
 SqlBegin('select notifytokenid from sy2devices where notifytokenid != ''''');  
 SqlBind(sDeviceId);  
 if(SqlExecute) then begin  
 while(SqlFetch) do begin  
 Request:=Client.GetRequest( 'Notification/CreateNotification/json' );  
 Request.SetMethod( 'POST' );  
 Request.AddParam('Payload',s);  
 Request.AddParam('DeviceId', sDeviceId);  
 Request.RunAsync( 'q\_jis\_rest\_ok', 'q\_jis\_rest\_fail' );

### **1.29 RecreateXAML**

### **1.30 CreateNewTransaction**

Function CreateNewTransaction(ProgramName: string): Boolean;  
  
Starts a program as a sub node in the current program by calling the StartProgram() function on the returned Transaction object. **Note that, in its initial version(s), this functionality is not available in the Desktop client.**
  

2 CreateNewTransaction
----------------------

### **2.1 CloseProgram**

Function CloseProgram(): Boolean;  
  
Closes the form/list window and closes the current program. Brings the client back to where it was before calling StartProgram().  
  
This function is not implemented in any Jeeves client.
  
  

### **2.2 ExpandProgram**

ExpandProgram(FieldName: string = ): Boolean;  
  
Opens a linked program. The input parameter specifies the field name from which the linked program is to be opened. The parameter is optional.  
  
This function is not implemented in any Jeeves client.  

### **2.3 GetFailReason**

Function GetFailReason: string;  
  
If a call to StartProgram or StartNode fails, returns a string to provide more a specific description of the error that has occurred.  
  
Note that this function is not implemented for the Desktop client.  

### **2.4 GoUp**

Function GoUp(): Boolean;  
  
Changes the program node to its parent node in a call to SubTransaction.  
  
Note that this function is not implemented for the Desktop client.  

### **2.5 StartNode**

Function StartNode(nodeName: string): Boolean;  
  
Opens the program node specified in the call to SubTransaction.  
  
Returns TRUE if able to open the specified program node. If the node cannot be opened the error is logged and the GetFailReason function is called.  
  
Note that this function is not implemented for the Desktop client.  

### **2.6 StartProgram**

Function StartProgram(): Boolean;  
  
Starts the program specified in the call to CreateNewTransaction. The program is opened as a sub node to the current program, with the form and list hidden.  
  
Returns TRUE if able to start the specified program. If the program cannot be started the error is logged and the GetFailReason function is called.  
  
Note that this function is not implemented for the Desktop client.  

3 DateTime
----------

The DateTime object represent a date and time. The object has attributes for date, time and time zone code.  
  
Example:  
...  
var  
 oTimeZones: Object;  
 oDateTime: Object;
begin  
 oTimeZones := Application.TimeZones;  
 oDateTime := oTimeZones.GetUTCDateTime;
end;  

### **3.1 Convert**

function Convert( iToTimeZoneCode: Integer ): Boolean;  
  
Converts the DateTime object to the specified time zone. Returns True if the convertion succeded otherwise false.  
  
Example:  
...  
var  
 oTimeZones: Object;  
 oDateTime: Object;  
 sMsg: string;
begin  
 oTimeZones := Application.TimeZones;  
 oDateTime := oTimeZones.GetUTCDateTime;  
  
// convert current date/time to Eastern time  
 if( oDateTime.Convert( 35 ) ) then begin  
 sMsg := 'The date and time in time zone 35 (' + oTimeZones.GetName( 35 );  
 sMsg := sMsg + ') is ' + oDateTime.Format( 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss' );  
 end  
 else begin  
 sMsg := 'Date and time conversion failed';  
 end;  
  
Message( sMsg );
end;  

### **3.2 Format**

function Format( sFormat: string ): string;  
  
Returns the date and time as a string according to the specified format.  
  
Format description:  
 c Displays the date using the format given by the ShortDateFormat  
 global variable, followed by the time using the format given by  
 the LongTimeFormat global variable. The time is not displayed if  
 the fractional part of the DateTime value is zero.  
  
d Displays the day as a number without a leading zero (1-31).  
  
dd Displays the day as a number with a leading zero (01-31).  
  
ddd Displays the day as an abbreviation (Sun-Sat) using the strings  
 given by the ShortDayNames global variable.  
  
dddd Displays the day as a full name (Sunday-Saturday) using the strings  
 given by the LongDayNames global variable.  
  
ddddd Displays the date using the format given by the ShortDateFormat  
 global variable.  
  
dddddd Displays the date using the format given by the LongDateFormat  
 global variable.  
  
g Displays the period/era as an abbreviation (Japanese and  
 Taiwanese locales only).  
  
gg Displays the period/era as a full name.  
  
e Displays the year in the current period/era as a number without  
 a leading zero (Japanese, Korean and Taiwanese locales only).  
  
ee Displays the year in the current period/era as a number with  
 a leading zero (Japanese, Korean and Taiwanese locales only).  
  
m Displays the month as a number without a leading zero (1-12). If  
 the m specifier immediately follows an h or hh specifier, the  
 minute rather than the month is displayed.  
  
mm Displays the month as a number with a leading zero (01-12). If  
 the mm specifier immediately follows an h or hh specifier, the  
 minute rather than the month is displayed.  
  
mmm Displays the month as an abbreviation (Jan-Dec) using the strings  
 given by the ShortMonthNames global variable.  
  
mmmm Displays the month as a full name (January-December) using the  
 strings given by the LongMonthNames global variable.  
  
yy Displays the year as a two-digit number (00-99).  
  
yyyy Displays the year as a four-digit number (0000-9999).  
  
h Displays the hour without a leading zero (0-23).  
  
hh Displays the hour with a leading zero (00-23).  
  
n Displays the minute without a leading zero (0-59).  
  
nn Displays the minute with a leading zero (00-59).  
  
s Displays the second without a leading zero (0-59).  
  
ss Displays the second with a leading zero (00-59).  
  
z Displays the millisecond without a leading zero (0-999).  
  
zzz Displays the millisecond with a leading zero (000-999).  
  
t Displays the time using the format given by the ShortTimeFormat  
 global variable.  
  
tt Displays the time using the format given by the LongTimeFormat  
 global variable.  
  
am/pm Uses the 12-hour clock for the preceding h or hh specifier, and  
 displays 'am' for any hour before noon, and 'pm' for any hour  
 after noon. The am/pm specifier can use lower, upper, or mixed  
 case, and the result is displayed accordingly.  
  
a/p Uses the 12-hour clock for the preceding h or hh specifier, and  
 displays 'a' for any hour before noon, and 'p' for any hour after  
 noon. The a/p specifier can use lower, upper, or mixed case, and  
 the result is displayed accordingly.  
  
ampm Uses the 12-hour clock for the preceding h or hh specifier, and  
 displays the contents of the TimeAMString global variable for any  
 hour before noon, and the contents of the TimePMString global  
 variable for any hour after noon.  
  
/ Displays the date separator character given by the DateSeparator  
 global variable.  
  
: Displays the time separator character given by the TimeSeparator  
 global variable.  
  
'xx' Characters enclosed in single or double quotes are displayed as-is,  
 "xx" and do not affect formatting.  
  
Format specifiers may be written in upper case as well as in lower case  
 letters--both produce the same result.  
  
If the string given by the sFormat parameter is empty, the date and time  
 value is formatted as if a 'c' format specifier had been given.  
  
Example:  
...  
var  
 oTimeZones: Object;  
 oDateTime: Object;
begin  
 oTimeZones := Application.TimeZones;  
 oDateTime := oTimeZones.GetUTCDateTime;  
 Message( 'UTC date/time: ' + oDateTime.Format( 'yyyy-mm-dd hh:nn:ss' ) );
end;  

### **3.3 GetDate**

function GetDate: Longint;  
  
Returns the value of the object's date attribute.  
  
Example:  
  
function DateFormat: boolean;

### **4.22 GetData**

Function GetData(string action): string  
  
Sends a message to the REST service, which in turn will activate a routine that will send an action value to the Mobile client.   
  
On receipt of this action value, the mobile client will decide which routine to call internally. The mobile client can implement different routines for different actions.  
  
Examples:   
 strVal := GetData(NFC);   
 If action value is 'NFC', it will call the routine that handles the activation of the NFC Reader and reads data from RFID/NFC tags. It then returns the RFID/NFC information in a macro variable.  
  
strVal := GetData('SomeFutureTechnology 1');   
 If action value is 'SomeFutureTechnology 1, it will call the routine that handles activation of 'SomeFutureTechnology 1' and reads data received through it.   
  
strVal := GetData('SomeFutureTechnology 2');   
 If action value is 'SomeFutureTechnology 2' it will call the routine that handles activation of 'SomeFutureTechnology 2' and reads data received through it.   
  
Note that this function will return an empty string if the following scenarios are encountered:  
 - there is no routine that can handle the action  
 - there is no data to read   
 - Near-field communication (NFC) permissions and NFC-enabled devices are not provided. In this case, it will not be able to read the data on the NFC-enabled mobile device.  

5 DynamicTabGrid
----------------

Represents the control object for the dynamic tab grid control. The tab object is retrieved through this config object.  

### **5.1 AddTab**

Function AddTab (RelativePosition, RelativeId, sNewTabId, sXML: string);  
  
AddTab (Relative Position, Relative Id, New Tab Id, XML)  
  
1. The integer specifying relative position at which the new tab needs to be inserted. Before = 1, After = 2, First = 3, Last = 4. This parameter value is used along with second parameter to place the tab at the desired index.   
 2. The string specifying relative tabs GUID. This will be empty if we are adding a new tab or last tab.  
 3. The string specifying new tabs GUID.   
 4. Row/s data in XML formatted string. The XML will specify the column definition.   
  
Example:   
 function AddTab: boolean;   
 var   
 oForm : object;   
 oTab : object;   
 oConfig : object;   
 begin   
 oForm := Application.GetCurrentForm;   
 oTab := oForm.GetTab(858);   
 oConfig := oTab.AddDynamicTabGrid('Configurator', 15, 150, 600, 300);;  
 oTab := oConfig.AddTab(0,'','HareRam','MyData1');  
 oTab := oConfig.AddTab(0,'','HareRam','MyData2');  
 AddTab:= True;   
 end;

### **7.2 EnableCell**

function EnableCell(RowID, CellID : String; bEnable : Boolean)  
  
EnableCell(Row ID, Cell ID, Enable/Disable)  
  
There are two ways to enable/disable a cell:   
 1. The XML supplied during the call to LoadXMLConfiguration, the XML node for cell information can contain an attribute called "enable": When enable=0 the cell will be disabled. When enable=1 the cell will be enabled.   
 2. Alternately, use EnableCell of the Configurator object.   
  
Example:  
 function EnableCell: boolean;  
 var  
 oForm : object;  
 oTab : object;  
 oConfig : object;  
 begin  
 oForm := Application.GetCurrentForm;  
 oConfig := oForm.GetDynamicTabGrid('Configurator');  
 oTab := oConfig.GetTab('101');  
 oCell2 := oTab.enablecell('205','3', False);  
 EnableCell := True;  
 end;

 end;

### **9.5 AddWebBrowser**

AddWebBrowser(sURL:string; iX, iY, iW, iH:integer)  
  
Opens an embedded web browser with the specified URL. The coordinates do not need to be set.
The function uses current version of Internet Explorer installed on the client computer.  
  
Code example for with reuse of webbrowser object (ie when changing records in a form)  
  
function addembWeb: boolean;
var  
 Tab, Form, Web, Node : Object;  
 s1:string;
begin  
 Form:=Application.GetCurrentForm;  
 Node:=Application.GetCurrentNode;  
 s1 := Node.GetOwnCachedData('webctrl');  
  
if (s1 = '') then begin  
 tab := form.gettab('test 1');  
 web := tab.AddWebBrowser( 'www.aftonbladet.se', 345, 200, 400, 300 );  
 s1 := web;  
 Node.SetOwnCachedData('webctrl',s1);  
 end else begin  
 web:=s1;  
 end;  
  
web.seturl('www.jeeves.se');
end;  
  
In the mobile client, the web browser is opened in separate window. In the other clients (Classic and Desktop), you have the option to open the web browser in a separate window.

### **9.18 SetXAMLProperty**

function SetXAMLProperty (tag, name, data);  
  
Function to customize components of the program (form). Currently, it is a mobile-specific function. **Note that the control tag is required in macro code (as it is in the relevant Design client properties).**  
  
Format description:  
 - Tag - Control tag  
 - Name - Name of property:  
 -- Title - Title of form  
  
The following properties are available for buttons:  
 -- Icon - Name of the icon  
 -- IconSize - Small/Medium/Large  
 -- Disable - True/False - Enable or disable use   
 -- Visible - True/False - Show or hide. If hidden, any control beneath it takes its place, i.e. hiding does not leave a blank space  
 -- Title - Title of the button  
  
The following properties are available for the Add button:  
 -- AddButtonPosition - Position of the Add button in the main list; Left, Right or Center. Example: form.SetXAMLProperty('list','AddButtonPosition','Right')  
 -- AddButtonTitle - Title of the Add button in the main list; Example: form.SetXAMLProperty('list','AddButtonTitle,'Add order')  
  
The following properties are available for the Edit button:  
 -- EditButtonVisibility - True/False  
 -- EditButtonColor - Color of the button in Integer format. Examples: Brown = 7250, Red = 8688  
 -- EditButtonPosition - Position of the Edit button in the form; Left, Right or Center. Example: form.SetXAMLProperty('form','EditButtonPosition','Right')  
 -- EditButtonTitle - Title of the Edit button in the form; Example: form.SetXAMLProperty('form','EditButtonTitle,'Edit order')  
  
The following property is available for the form's main list and embedded list(s):  
 -- isMultiSelect - True/False. Disable/enable selection of multiple records in the list. Example: form.setxamlproperty("list","isMultiSelect","false")  
   
 The following property is available for the Back button:  
 -- SkipList - True/False. Skips the list window when the Back button is clicked from the form. Example: form.SetXAMLProperty('LSkipList','SkipList','true');  
  
The following property is available for expandable areas in the form:  
 -- IsExpanded - True/False  
   
 The following property is available in the form:  
 -- IsAlwaysAddMode - True/False  
 -- IsEnableSearchMode - True/False  
   
 The following property is available for the embedded list in the form:  
 -- MaxCountForEmbeddedList - Maximum No. of records to be displayed in the embedded list. The default value is 5 and the maximum value is 30. Example: form.SetXAMLProperty('MaxCount','MaxCountForEmbeddedList',10);  
   
 - Data - Property data  
 -- IsDisable - True/False. Example: form.SetXAMLProperty(ex\_control,IsDisable,true);  
 -- Title - Title of expandable area. Example: form.SetXAMLProperty(ex\_control,Title,New title);

### **9.20 GetMapViewer**

Function GetMapViewer(sNameOrGuid: string;); object;  
  
Returns the mapviewer object that is part of the form and that has either the same name or Guid as the supplied argument.  
  
Example:  
 var  
 form: Object;  
 mapViewer: Object;  
 htmlViewer: object;  
 begin  
 form:=application.getcurrentform;  
 mapViewer:= form.getmapviewer('41372D9D-3853-4859-890C-25308124331C');  
 mapViewer.navigate('gcn enclave', 'orion mall');  
 end;  
  
Recommendation  
 ----------------------  
This code can run into problems in certain scenarios, for example if the related search results in one single record. Our recommendation is to use the SetXAMLProperty function with "map" as a tag, which avoids such potential problems.  
  
Use form.SetXAMLProperty('map'...). This assumes that you also set the tag on the form object in the Design client to 'map'. See the SetXAMLProperty function documentation and the Macro examples chapter for further information.

### **9.25 AddImage**

function AddImage( iX, iY, iW, iH:integer;sImageFile:string):Object;  
  
Identifies the added form window (ignoring the coordinates in the macro call) and loads it with the linked file(s).  
  
The SetImageFile command clears the image control functionality and replaces it with a new image while the ClearImages command empties the image control to enable the loading of new images when changing the underlying record in the form.  
  
**Code example adding an image to a tab and cache the image control for reuse:**  
  
function fa\_addimage: boolean;  
 var  
 oForm:Object;  
 oNode:Object;  
 oTab:Object;  
 oImage:Object;  
 s1:string;  
 begin  
  
oForm:=Application.GetCurrentForm;  
 oNode := Application.GetCurrentNode;  
 s1 := oNode.GetOwnCachedData('imagectrl');  
  
if (s1 = '') then begin  
 oTab := oForm.gettab('test1');  
 oImage:=oTab.AddImage(300,58,200,200,'c:\temp\flag\_iwojima\_lg.jpg');  
 s1 := oImage;  
 oNode.SetOwnCachedData('imagectrl',s1);  
 end else begin  
 oImage:=s1;  
 oImage.setimagefile('c:\temp\jeeves.jpg');  
 end;  
  
To this you also have to add macro code in event program restart or program leave that empties the cache (like below).  
 oNode.SetOwnCachedData('imagectrl','');  
  
**Code example adding multiple images to a tab:**  
  
function fa\_addmultipleimages: boolean;  
 var  
 oForm:Object;  
 oNode:Object;  
 oTab:Object;  
 oImage:Object;  
 s1:string;  
 begin  
  
oForm:=Application.GetCurrentForm;  
 oNode := Application.GetCurrentNode;  
 s1 := oNode.GetOwnCachedData('imagectrl');  
  
if (s1 = '') then begin  
 oTab := oForm.gettab('test1');  
 oImage:=oTab.AddImage(300,58,200,200,'c:\temp\flag\_iwojima\_lg.jpg');  
 oTab.AddImage(300,58,200,200,'c:\temp\flag\_iwojima\_lg1.jpg');  
 oTab.AddImage(300,58,200,200,'c:\temp\flag\_iwojima\_lg2.jpg');  
 oTab.AddImage(300,58,200,200,'c:\temp\flag\_iwojima\_lg3.jpg');  
 s1 := oImage;  
 oNode.SetOwnCachedData('imagectrl',s1);  
 end else begin  
 oImage:=s1;  
 oImage.clearimages;  
 oTab := oForm.gettab('test1');  
 oTab.AddImage(300,58,200,200,'c:\temp\flag\_iwojima\_lg1.jpg');  
 oTab.AddImage(300,58,200,200,'c:\temp\flag\_iwojima\_lg2.jpg');  
 oTab.AddImage(300,58,200,200,'c:\temp\flag\_iwojima\_lg3.jpg');  
 end;  
  
**Code example clearing images from a form:**  
  
function fa\_clearing: boolean;  
 var  
 oForm:Object;  
 oNode:Object;  
 oImage:Object;  
 s1:object;  
 begin  
 oForm:=Application.GetCurrentForm;  
 oNode := Application.GetCurrentNode;  
 s1 := oNode.GetOwnCachedData('imagectrl');  
  
if (s1 <> ' ') then begin  
 s1.ClearImages();  
 end;  
 end;

11 Graph
--------

Contains methods to handle a business graphic object.  

### **11.1 Close**

procedure Close();  
  
Deletes graph object  

### **11.2 LoadData**

procedure LoadData();  
  
Loads graph with the data returned by the sql clause.  

### **11.3 SetBounds**

procedure SetBounds(iX,iY,iWidth, iHeight:integer);  
  
Sets the graph objects position and size.  

### **11.4 SetColors**

procedure SetColors( '0000FF@FF0000' ); or SetColors( 'clred@clblue' );  
  
Sets the colors on the serie(s) in the business chart. If there are several series, separate the colors with @. Color can be given with either a hexadecimal value or plain text with the prefix cl.  
  
Example:   
 SetColors('0000FF@FF0000');   
 SetColors('clred');  
  
When the different colors setting is applied, this parameter will have no effect.  

### **11.5 SetGraphSql**

procedure SetGraphSql(sSql:string);  
  
Sets the sql clause that sets up the graph.  

### **11.6 SetMetaData**

procedure SetMetaData(sData:string);  
  
Defines prompt, table.fieldname and datatype separated with | for the fields included in the graph. The field order, separated by $$, corresponds to the column order in the linked SQL query.   

### **11.7 SetType**

procedure SetType(sType:string);  
  
Defines several settings for a graph with a $ separated string. The different positions control the following settings.  
  
Position 1: Graph type ( 0 = Bar chart, 1 = Line chart, 2 = Pie chart)  
  
Position 2: Field used for grouping  
  
Position 3: Field(s) used as value field. @ is used as separator if there are several fields.  
  
Position 4: Format settings separated with @  
 Position 4.1: Rotation (No rotation = 0/360)  
 Position 4.2: Elevation (No elevation = 0/360)  
 Position 4.3: Horizontal offset on window (No offset = 0)  
 Position 4.4: Vertical offset on window (No offset = 0)  
 Position 4.5: Zoom (Default = 100)  
 Position 4.6: 3D Deep (No deep = 0)  
 Position 4.7: Toggle 3D (1/0)  
 Position 4.8: Toggle Different colors (1/0)  
 Position 4.9: Show ledger/Display key (1/0)  
 Position 4.10: Show Chart prompt (1/0)  
 Position 4.11: Chart prompt  
 Position 4.12: Show Grouping axis prompt (1/0)  
 Position 4.13: Grouping axis prompt  
 Position 4.14: Show Value axis prompt (1/0)  
 Position 4.15: Value axis prompt  
 Position 4.16: Marks style on data points. Possible values are:  
 *0 = Not visible  
 1 = Value  
 2 = Percent  
 3 = Label  
 4 = Label and Percent  
 5 = Label and Value  
 6 = Legend  
 7 = Percent total  
 8 = Label and Percent  
 9 = X value  
 10 = X and Y Value*

### **13.1 FieldExists**

Parameter to check whether a given field exists in a form (can be invisble), for example if you intend to call SetFieldProperty but do not know if the field exists.

oForm = Application.GetCurrentList;

begin

### **13.2 GetCellValue**

function GetCellValue(iRow:integer; sTblName, sFldName:string);  
  
Returns the current cell value for the given table column on the given row.  
  
To get the first row, set iRow = 0.  
  
Example code for a loop loop, executing a procedure for each row in the list.  
  
//1. Get the list object:  
 oList := Application.getCurrentList;  
  
//2. Retrieve the number of rows in the list:  
 iRowCount := oList.GetRowCount;  
  
//3. Define fields to retrieve.  
 sTableName:= xx;  
 sFieldName1 := yyyyyyy;  
 sFieldName2 := zzzzzzzz;   
  
//4. Retrieve the desired fields for the current row and execute the procedure.  
 For iRow :=1 to iRowCount do  
 begin   
 iField1 := oList.GetCellValue(iRow-1,sTableName, sFieldName1);  
 sField2 := oList.GetCellValue(iRow-1,sTableName, sFieldName2);  
 SQLexecutetext(EXEC sp\_MyJob(+ToSql(iField1) +,+ ToSql(sField2) + );  
 end;

17 ProductConfigurator
----------------------

Represents the control object for the tab grid control for Jeeves Product configurator. The tab object is retrieved through this config object.  
  
Note that the Product configurator objects and their methods have been deprecated and should not be used to build the dynamic tab grid, an embedded list with tabs used to present data. Instead, use the Dynamic tab grid objects and their methods to build up the tab grid control.  

### **17.1 AddTab**

AddTab (RelativePosition, RelativeId, sNewTabId, sXML: string);  
  
AddTab (Relative Position, Relative Id, New Tab Id, XML)  
  
1) The integer specifying relative position at which the new tab needs to be inserted. Before = 1, After = 2, First = 3, Last = 4. This parameter value is used along with second parameter to place the tab at the desired index.  
  
2) The string specifying relative tabs GUID. This will be empty if we are adding a new tab or last tab.  
  
3) The string specifying new tabs GUID.  
  
4) Row/s data in XML formatted string. The XML will specify the column definition.  
  
Example:  
  
function AddTab: boolean;
var  
 oForm : object;  
 oTab : object;  
 oConfig : object;
begin  
 oForm := Application.GetCurrentForm;  
 oTab := oForm.GetTab(858);  
 oConfig := oTab.AddProductConfigurator('Configurator', 15, 150, 600, 300);;  
 oTab := oConfig.AddTab(0,'','HareRam','MyData1');  
 oTab := oConfig.AddTab(0,'','HareRam','MyData2');  
 end; AddTab:= True;
end;

### **19.2 EnableCell**

EnableCell(RowID, CellID : String; bEnable : Boolean)  
  
EnableCell(Row ID, Cell ID, Enable/Disable)  
  
There are two ways to enable/disable a cell.  
  
1) The XML supplied during the call to LoadXMLConfiguration, the XML node for cell information can contain an attribute called "enable":  
 When enable=0 the cell will be disabled.   
 When enable=1 the cell will be enabled.   
  
2) Alternately, use EnableCell of the Configurator object.   
  
Example:  
  
function EnableCell: boolean;
var  
 oForm : object;  
 oTab : object;  
 oConfig : object;
begin  
 oForm := Application.GetCurrentForm;  
 oConfig := oForm.GetProductConfigurator('Configurator');  
 oTab := oConfig.GetTab('101');  
 oCell2 := oTab.enablecell('205','3', False);  
 EnableCell := True;
end;

 AddRow := True;

### **22.6 NoPrintOut**

function NoPrintOut(bBool);  
  
The NoPrintOut parameter on the report object allows you to specify if a report associated with a template should produce a printout when the report is run.  
  
The NoPrintOut parameter takes the following values:  
 - True: Specifies that a report printout is not generated when the report is run.  
 - False: Specifies that a report printout is generated when the report is run.  
  
Example: To execute a report to process a customer invoice without generating a printout.  
  
function report: boolean;  
 Var  
 sCondition: string;  
 oReport : object;  
 Begin  
 sCondition:=GetCondStr;  
 oReport:=application.getreport('rfakt'); //report name is rfakt  
 oReport.NoPrintOut(True);  
 oReport.run('templatename',sCondition,'');   
  
end;

Sets the export format.  
For example to export to pdf set the inparameter to pdf.  

### **22.15 SetParams**

### **22.16 SetProgramRestart**

procedure SetProgramRestart(bRestart:Boolean);  
  
When printing reports that dosent exist in current program this parameter can be used to block
the restart of current program after report end.  
  
It is neccessary to set this to false when printing out more than 10 reports at once or else there will
be a "out of que space" message. If you want to stay in the program you have to, at the end of macro
restart the program.  
  
Is added as of version 2.1.0s and 2.2.0a.  
  
Example:  
  
function fa\_report: boolean;
var  
 cReport : Object;  
 cList:Object;  
 i:integer;  
 sActiveProgram:string;
sFtgnr:string;
begin  
 cList:=Application.GetCurrentList;  
 sActiveProgram := GetActiveProgram;  
 cReport := application.GetReport('rFtg1');  
 cReport.SetProgramRestart(false);  
 For i:=0 to cList.GetRowCount-1 do begin  
 sFtgNr := cList.GetCellValue(i,'kus','ftgnr');  
 cReport.SetCondition('fr.ftgnr=' + ToSQL( sFtgNr ));  
 cReport.RunExport('fa\_ftg\_test','c:\temp\utskrift2\_' + sFtgNr + '.pdf',false);  
 End;  
 GoToProgram(sActiveProgram,'');
end;  

23 Request
----------

Object that is used to make a request.  

### **23.1 AddParam**

Procedure AddParam( sName, sValue : string );  
  
Adds the specified parameters to the call.  
  
Sample:  
 obj.AddParam( Sandbox, true );  
 obj.AddParam( email, info@jeeves.se );  

### **23.2 RunAsync**

Procedure RunAsync(sOnSucess : string; sOnFail : string);  
  
Adds the request to the call queue. The call with be executed as soon as possible. Two macros can be supplied, the first one if it is a success and the second if is a failure.  
  
Sample: obj.RunAsync( rest\_call\_ok, rest\_call\_fail );  
  
Example:  
  
function rest\_call\_ok ( request : Object ): boolean;
var  
 json : object;
begin  
 json := request.GetResponse; (\* Is a JSON object \*)  
  
.  
end  
  
function rest\_call\_fail ( request : Object ): boolean;
begin
end;  

### **23.3 SetContentType**

Procedure SetContentType(sType: string);  
  
Sets the content-type http header.  

### **23.4 SetMethod**

procedure SetMethod( sMethod : string );  
  
Sets the HTTP method for the REST request.  

### **23.5 GetResponse**

Function GetResponse; Object;  
  
Returns the response as a JSON object.  

### **23.6 SetRetries**

Procedure SetRetries( iRetry : integer );  
  
Sets the number of retries to be performed before a request is timed out or fails.  

### **23.7 SetTimeout**

Procedure SetTimeout( iTimeount: Integer);  
  
Sets the maximum allowed duration for a call before a response is given. If the specified time is exceeded, the call is counted as a failure.  

### **23.8 AddBearerToken**

Procedure AddBearerToken(sValue: string);  
  
Adds an authentication parameter as a bearer token.  
  
Sample:  
 sToken := eyJhbGciOiJSUzI1NiIsImtpZCI6IkI3NTVGQUE5QTdCMTdFMTlFMzc3RTFBRENFNDk5QjY4NzdDM0UwQTYiCJ0eXAiOiJKV1QiLCJ4NXQiOiJ0MVg2cWFleGZobmpkLUd0emttYmFIZkQ0S1kifQ.eyJuYmYiOjE1NDI2Mjk1NTQsImV4cCI6MTU0MjY2;  
  
requestObj.AddBearerToken(sToken);  

### **23.9 AddBody**

Procedure AddBody(sValue: string);  
  
Adds the specified JSON string to the body section of the request object. Note that AddBody accepts only a JSON string.  
  
Sample:  
 sBody := {"state":"Destroyed"};  
 requestObj.AddBody(sBody);  

### **23.10 AddHeader**

Procedure AddHeader(sName, sValue: string);  
  
Adds the specified parameter in the header of the request object.  
  
Sample:  
 requestObj.AddHeader('Accept-Language', 'sv' );  
  
This procedure includes a boolean type optional parameter, so when it is called with two parameters or with value for third parameter as True, the passed string is encoded. However, if the encoding is not required, the third parameter should be passed as False.   
  
Example:  
 Encoding required:  
 AddHeader('XXXX', 'abcd/ e');  
 AddHeader('XXXX', 'abcd/ e', True);  
  
Encoding not required:  
 AddHeader('XXXX', 'abcd/ e', False);  

### **23.11 GetParam**

function GetParam(sName: string ): string;  
  
Gets the value for the parameter that was added to the request object.  
  
Sample:  
 requestObj.GetParam('batch');  
 requestObj.GetParam('expiry');  

### **23.12 GetResponseStatusCode**

function GetResponseStatusCode: Integer;  
  
Returns the status code of the response as received from the web service. Status codes are issued by a server in response to a client's request made to the server. This function does not take any parameter. Returns an integer value.  
  
Example:  
 Var  
 iStatusCode: Integer;  
 begin  
 iStausCode := requestObj.GetResponseStatusCode();  
 end;  

24 RestObject
-------------

Used to construct a REST service request.  

### **24.1 CreateBasicAuthenticator**

Procedure CreateBasicAuthenticator( sUsername : string, sPassword : string );  
  
Sets user name and password for REST calls that require authentication.
  
  

### **24.2 GetRequest**

Function GetRequest (sResource: string)  
  
Returns a request object that can be used to access a REST service (resource) available in the base URL given to the REST client.   

### **24.3 SetContentType**

Procedure SetContentType(sType: string);  
  
Sets the content type http header that lets the REST service know which type of data (content) is in the incoming request. Used in a call to the Jeeves Service builder, it is typically set to application/x-www-form-urlencoded ; charset=UTF-8   
  
However, it can also be set to a number of content types formats. The most common for calling REST services which is content structured as JSON data is application/json; charset=utf-8.   

25 SqlOutputToFile
------------------

This function returns the SqlOutputToFile object.   
  
var  
 O : object;  
 path : string;
begin  
 O := Application.SqlOutputToFile;  
 if O = 0 then begin  
 Message( 'Application.SqlOutputToFile is not implemented in current kernel version' );  
 Exit;  
 end;  
  
//Message( O.members ); // show all members to object SqlOutputToFile  
  
path := 'D:\Jeeves'; //Any valid directory path within single quotes or variables and fields  
  
if copy ( path , length ( path ) , 1 ) <> '\' then  
 path := path + '\';  
  
path := path + 'FixFiles\Nisse1.txt';  
 //Message( path );  
  
O.AsSingleColumn( TRUE ); // default = TRUE  
 O.AddNewLineAtEndOfRow( TRUE ); // default = TRUE  
 O.PrintErrMsg( FALSE ); // default = TRUE if false then check Status and Message  
 O.FileName( path );  
 O.MaxColLength(10);  
 O.SqlStmt( 'select cast(12345 as varchar(20));' );  
 O.Execute;  
 if O.getStatus <> 0 then begin  
 message( 'Error executing Application.SqlOutputToFile.'  
 + NewLine + 'Status = ' + O.GetStatus  
 + NewLine + 'Error message = ' + O.GetMessage  
 );  
 end else begin  
 message( 'OK'  
 + NewLine + 'GetNumberOfRows = ' + O.GetNumberOfRows  
 + NewLine + 'GetNumberOfChars = ' + O.GetNumberOfChars  
 + NewLine + 'GetMaxRowLength = ' + O.GetMaxRowLength  
 );  
 end;  
 end;
  

### **25.1 AsSingleColumn**

procedure AsSingleColumn( flag : boolean);  
  
default TRUE, concat all columns to a single column  

### **25.2 execute**

function execute() : boolean;  
  
Outputs the SQL result to the file specified in filename parameter and returns information on whether the action is a success or failure.

### **25.4 GetStatus**

Returns the following status codes with error messages:

 - 'No Sql stmt?'; Status := 21;   
 - 'Error open file '; Status := 12;  
 - 'SQL ERROR; dbcmd;'; Status := 22;  
 - 'SQL ERROR; dbsqlexec;'; Status := 23;  
 - 'Max 10 columns to bind, '; Status := 1;  
 - OK = 0

Dynamic tab grid  
 --------------------  
 Note that the Product configurator methods have been deprecated and should not be used to build the dynamic tab grid, an embedded list with tabs used to present data. Instead, use the Dynamic tab grid objects and their methods to build up the tab grid control.  

### **26.1 AddEmbeddedCom**

### **26.2 AddGraph**

function AddGraph(sName:string;iX, iY, iW, iH : integer):Object;  
  
Adds a graph to the form at the specified coordinates and returns an object of the type GraphObject.

### **26.3 AddImage**

function AddImage( iX, iY, iW, iH:integer;sImageFile:string):Object;  
  
Identifies the added form window (ignoring the coordinates in the macro call) and loads it with the linked file(s).  
  
The SetImageFile command clears the image control functionality and replaces it with a new image while the ClearImages command empties the image control to enable the loading of new images when changing the underlying record in the form.  
  
Code example adding an image to a tab and cache the image control for reuse.  
  
Example:  
 function fa\_addimage: boolean;  
 var  
 oForm:Object;  
 oNode:Object;  
 oTab:Object;  
 oImage:Object;  
 s1:string;  
 begin  
  
oForm:=Application.GetCurrentForm;  
 oNode := Application.GetCurrentNode;  
 s1 := oNode.GetOwnCachedData('imagectrl');  
  
if (s1 = '') then begin  
 oTab := oForm.gettab('test1');  
 oImage:=oTab.AddImage(300,58,200,200,'c:\temp\flag\_iwojima\_lg.jpg');  
 s1 := oImage;  
 oNode.SetOwnCachedData('imagectrl',s1);  
 end else begin  
 oImage:=s1;  
 oImage.ClearImages();  
 oImage.setimagefile('c:\temp\jeeves.jpg');  
 end;  
  
To this you also have to add macro code in event program restart or program leave that empties the cache (like below).  
 oNode.SetOwnCachedData('imagectrl','');  
  
Code example clearing images from a form:  
  
function fa\_clearing: boolean;  
 var  
 oForm:Object;  
 oNode:Object;  
 oImage:Object;  
 s1:object;  
 begin  
 oForm:=Application.GetCurrentForm;  
 oNode := Application.GetCurrentNode;  
 s1 := oNode.GetOwnCachedData('imagectrl');  
  
if (s1 <> ' ') then begin  
 s1.ClearImages();  
 end;
end;

### **26.11 Visible**

Visible(bValue:Boolean);  
  
Used to hide a tab or retrieve an earlier hidden tab.  
  
The following example will ask the user if the tab with tab ID 2680 should be hidden. If the user clicks Yes, the tab will be hidden for that particular program instance:  
  
function q\_MenuCommand: boolean;  
 var  
 Form, oTab: object;  
 iValue: Integer;  
 s: string;  
 begin  
 Form:=Application.GetCurrentForm;  
 oTab := Form.GetTab('2680');  
 iValue := oTab.getId;  
 s:= oTab.GetCaption;  
 Message(iValue + s);  
 if yesno('Hide tab: '+ iValue + ' ' + s + '?') then oTab.visible(false);  
 end;  
  
To retrieve the hidden tab, you need to change the oTab.visible parameter to true as follows:  
  
function q\_MenuCommand: boolean;  
 var  
 Form, oTab: object;  
 iValue: Integer;  
 s: string;  
 begin  
 Form:=Application.GetCurrentForm;  
 oTab := Form.GetTab('2680');  
 iValue := oTab.getId;  
 s:= oTab.GetCaption;  
 Message(iValue + s);  
 if yesno('Retrieve tab: '+ iValue + ' ' + s + '?') then oTab.visible(True);  
 end;
