1 Nytt program fr hantering av importerade leverantrsfakturor med fel i data
----------------------------------------------------------------------------

### **Preliminr import/inlsta leverantrsfakturor** [(Program: xPrelimPvLr)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_xPrelimPvLr.HTM)

Program fr hantering av importerade leverantrsfakturor med fel i data.
Frn det hr programmet kan du visa PDF-filerna med de preliminra leverantrsfakturorna. Du kan ven kontrollera om det finns fel i data (till exempel felaktigt fakturadatum eller om fakturan redan finns i leverantrsreskontran). Om du hittar ett fel kan du korrigera data och sedan verfra fakturan till tabellen Granska importerad leverantrsfaktura (pvlr), eller s kan du radera den.
Du br kontrollera det hr programmet regelbundet och hlla det uppdaterat.
Observera att programmet ocks kan ns som en nod i programmet Granska importerade leverantrsfakturor (xpvlr).

2 Nytt flt fr att definiera om betalningsfilen fr SEPA br summeras eller inte
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------

Ett nytt flt har lagts till i fljande program fr att definiera om fakturainformation br summeras i SEPA-betalningsfilen.
- Fakturabetalningsservice (xjfbs)
- Fakturabetalningsservice med kontering (nxjfbs)  

#### Aktuella/viktiga flt/knappar

##### **Summera SEPA-fil** [(Flt:: Summarized)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_Summarized.HTM)

Funktion fr att definiera om betalningsfilen fr SEPA br summeras eller inte.
- Om ikryssat (sant) grupperas fakturainformationen i betalningsfilen fr SEPA. Detta innebr att alla betalningar med samma datum och valuta fr varje leverantr summeras till ett totalt utbetalningsbelopp och att information frn alla fakturor specificeras p en rad (nr filen r ostrukturerad, t.ex. om x2uv.utborsak = A), eller att varje komponent i informationen visas p en separat rad (nr filen r strukturerad; t.ex. om x2uv.utborsak r ngot annat n A). Detta mste gras om du betalar kreditfakturor, eftersom det inte r tilltet att skicka negativa utbetalningssummor i SEPA-betalningsfilen.
- Om ej ikryssat (falskt) specificeras fakturainformationen i betalningsfilen fr SEPA. Detta innebr att varje faktura specificeras separat i SEPA-betalningsfilen.
Som standard rvs vrdet frn applikationsparametern ACCPAY064 till det hr fltet, men det kan ndras vid behov.  
  

3 Std fr avprickning av kontrakt
--------------------------------

### **3.1 Nytt flt fr hantering av differensbeloppet under avprickning av kontrakt**

Ett nytt flt har lagts till i noden Kontraktskonteringsmall i programmet Inkpsavtal/offerfrfrgan, leverantr (bha) fr att lta dig definiera hur differensbeloppet ska hanteras under avprickning av fakturor.  

#### Aktuella/viktiga flt/knappar

##### **Konto differenstolerans** [(Flt:: TolDiffAcct)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_TolDiffAcct.HTM)

Om fakturabeloppet ligger inom toleransgrnsen, konteras differensbeloppet (d.v.s. Fakturabelopp - Kontraktsperiodens belopp) enligt fljande:
- Om den hr kryssrutan r ikryssad konteras differensbeloppet mot kontokoden p debetsidan om den r strre n noll; annars p kreditsidan.
- Om den inte r ikryssad verfrs fakturan till Workflow-fldet.  
  

### **3.2 Mjlighet att ha olika leverantrer p faktura och kontrakt**

Nr leverantren som angetts i programmet Leverantrsfakturor (Supplinvcs/xlr) skiljer sig frn den i kontraktet och parametern ACCPAY083 r satt till Y, visas ett varningsmeddelande om olika leverantrs-id p fakturan och kontraktet visas, men du kan fortstta att skapa en leverantrsfaktura. Om parametern ACCPAY083 r satt till N, visas ett felmeddelande och du kan inte fortstta att skapa leverantrsfakturan.
Om leverantren som anges i programmet Granskning importerade lev.fakturor (xPvlr) och i kontraktet r olika, initieras alternativt tgrden som beskrivs nedan nr du klickar p fljande knapp:  

### Aktuella funktionsknappar/berknade flt

#### **Granska** [(Knapp/flt: PB\_Set\_Reviewed\_PvLr)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_PB_Set_Reviewed_PvLr.HTM)

Funktion fr automatisk granskning av leverantrsfakturor. Funktionen kryssar i rutan Granskat (checkpvlr) om alla data som det finns kontroller p finns p posterna och granskningsresultatet r OK.
Om leverantren som anges i programmet Granskning importerade lev.fakturor (xPvlr) och kontraktet r olika, initieras fljande tgrd nr du trycker p den hr knappen:
- Om parametern ACCPAY083 r satt till Y stts fltet Status till OK och kryssrutan Granskad (CheckPvlr) blir ikryssad (SANT). Du kan fortstta skapa leverantrsfakturan om du vill.
- Om parametern ACCPAY083 r satt till N, stts fltet Status till Olika leverantrer p faktura och kontrakt och kryssrutan Granskad (CheckPvlr) avmarkeras (FALSKT). Du kan inte fortstta skapa leverantrsfakturan.
Den hr funktionen validerar ocks om det finns flera leverantrsfakturor fr samma kontraktsperiod nr parametern ACCPAY084 r instlld p N. I det hr fallet kontrollerar Jeeves om det redan finns en faktura fr kontraktsperioden i programmet Inkpsavtal/offerfrfrgan, leverantr (bha). Om en avprickning hittas visar fltet Status meddelandet Fakturan r redan avprickad fr kontraktsperioden (se JVSP-parametern ACCPAY084), kryssrutan Granskad frblir omarkerad och du kan inte fortstta skapa leverantrsfakturan.  
  

### **3.3 Procentsats fr frdelning av belopp i stllet fr fast belopp**

### **Inkpsavtal/offertfrfrgan, leverantr** [(Program: bha)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_bha.HTM)

Fljande flt har lagts till i noden Kontraktskonteringsmall i programmet Inkpsavtal/offert/frfrgan, leverantr (bha) s att du kan ange en procentsats i stllet fr ett fast belopp nr du definierar kontraktskonteringsmallen.
Som resultat r Belopp (fordbel) inte lngre tillgngligt fr anvndning vid definiering av kontraktskonteringsmallen.  

#### Aktuella/viktiga flt/knappar

##### **Procent** [(Flt:: fordproc)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_fordproc.HTM)

Procentsats fr frdelning av belopp eller antal/kvantiteter. Om ingen procentsats anges, och dr det finns beloppsflt dr inte heller ngot belopp har angetts, r 100 % underfrsttt.
Observera att frdelningsprocenten inte br verstiga 100 fr varken debet- eller kreditkonteringar.  
  

### **3.4 Mjlighet att tillta flera leverantrsfakturor under samma kontraktsperiod**

Nr du skapar en leverantrsfaktura frn programmet Leverantrsfakturor (xlr/supplinvcs) sker fljande:
Jeeves kontrollerar om det redan finns ngon faktura fr kontraktsperioden i programmet Inkpsavtal/offertfrfrgan, leverantr (bha). Om en avprickning hittas och parametern ACCPAY084 r satt till Y, visas ett varningsmeddelande om att fakturan redan r avprickad fr kontraktsperioden. Du kan dock fortstta skapa en leverantrsfaktura genom att klicka p OK. Om parametern ACCPAY084 r satt till N, visas ett felmeddelande och du kan inte fortstta att skapa leverantrsfakturan.
Nr du skapar/ndrar en post i programmet Granska importerade leverantrsfakturor (xpvlr):
- Genom att klicka p knappen Granska (PB\_Set\_Reviewed\_PvLr)
-- Om parametern ACCPAY084 r satt till Y, fylls kryssrutan Granskat i automatiskt och fltet Status stts till OK.
-- Om parametern ACCPAY084 r satt till N kontrollerar Jeeves om det redan finns ngon faktura fr kontraktsperioden i programmet Inkpsavtal/offertfrfrgan, leverantr (bha). Om en avprickning hittas visar fltet Status meddelandet Fakturan r redan avprickad fr kontraktsperioden (se JVSP-parametern ACCPAY084), kryssrutan Granskad frblir omarkerad och du kan inte fortstta skapa leverantrsfakturan.
- Genom att manuellt redigera posten genom att markera kryssrutan Granskat. I det hr fallet,
-- Om parametern ACCPAY084 r satt till Y, stts fltet Status till OK.
-- Om parametern ACCPAY084 r satt till N kontrollerar Jeeves om det redan finns ngon faktura fr kontraktsperioden i programmet Inkpsavtal/offertfrfrgan, leverantr (bha). Om en avprickning hittas visas ett felmeddelande med information om att fakturan redan r avprickad fr kontraktsperioden (se JVSP-parametern ACCPAY084). Felmeddelandet uppdateras ocks i fltet Status, kryssrutan Granskad avmarkeras och du kan inte fortstta skapa leverantrsfakturan.  

### **3.5 Nya applikationsparametrar**

Applikationsparametrarna ACCPAY083 och hgre har infrts i JAS version 15.0.9.
Fr information om alla applikationsparametrar fr modulen Leverantrsreskontra, se kapitlet (vid lsning online, klicka p lnken nedan):  

### [**Applikationsparametrar fr Leverantrsreskontra**](ms-its:DocAreas_SE.chm::/doc_579.HTM)

1 Std fr uppdaterad version av strukturen fr JPK\_VAT-faktura
-------------------------------------------------------------

En ny, uppdaterad version av strukturen fr JPK\_VAT-fakturan har publicerats fr moms- och redovisningsdokument, som brjar glla frn 1 januari 2022 (JPK\_V7M och V7K).
Jeeves har infrt fljande funktionalitet till std fr den nya versionen av strukturen.  

### **1.1 Nytt flt fr att ange Frfallo-/betalningsdatum**

### **Registrera intern momsfaktura, frsljning** [(Program: IntInv)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_IntInv.HTM)

#### Aktuella/viktiga flt/knappar

##### **Frfallo-/betaln.datum** [(Flt:: DuePaymentDt)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_DuePaymentDt.HTM)

Ange frfallodatum eller betalningsdatum fr korrigeringstransaktioner fr avskrivning av kundfrluster.  
  

### **1.2 Ny kryssruta som indikerar elektroniska leveransgrnssnitt fr frsljningstransaktioner**

### **Momstyper** [(Program: x1d)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_x1d.HTM)

#### Aktuella/viktiga flt/knappar

##### **Elektroniska grnssnitt** [(Flt:: IED)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_IED.HTM)

Om ikryssat visas IED-taggen i momsrapporten fr Polen.
IED r den beteckning som anvnds av skattebetalare fr att via ett elektroniskt grnssnitt (t.ex. en onlinebutik) underltta fljande transaktioner som utfrs inom EU: gemenskapsintern distansfrsljning av varor eller leverans av varor till en ej skattepliktig enhet av en tredje part, till exempel en skattebetalare som inte finns i EU eller ett fast driftsstlle inom EU.
Vrdet som anges i den hr kryssrutan i programmet Momstyper (x1d) rvs till programmet Kundfakturor, huvud (fh) och drifrn till programmet Momstransaktioner (tax).  
  

### **1.3 Formatndringar i den polska standardrevisionsfilen**

ndringar krvs nr en anvndare genererar de polska standardrevisionsfilerna JPK\_V7K och JPK\_V7M frn 2022 och framt. Fr filer som genererats innan 2022 behlls det befintliga formatet.
Alla taggar som ndras eller lggs till enligt den nya strukturen indikeras i fljande avsnitt i kapitlet (klicka p lnken nedan om du lser online)
- JPK\_V7K (polsk standardrevisionsfil fr kvartalsvis momsrapportering)
- JPK\_V7M (polsk standardrevisionsfil fr mnadsvis momsrapportering)

1 Nytt program och funktion fr visning av AP-avstmningsrapport p skrm
---------------------------------------------------------------------

### 1.1 **AP - Avrkningskonto avstmning** [(Program: APClAcctRecon)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_APClAcctRecon.HTM)

Program fr avstmning av interimsavrkningskontots saldo i reskontran och leverantrsskulder i huvudboken p skrmen.
Avstmningsunderlaget fr interimskontot innehller alla fakturor som inte r slutattesterade per angivet avstmningsdatum.
Klicka p knappen Skapa avstmningsposter (PB\_APClAcctRecon\_CreRcds) och besvara frgan om bearbetningsdatum. Gr sedan en skning. Alla leverantrsfakturor med saldon p interimskonto(n) i leverantrsreskontran fr angivet bearbetningsdatum visas i listan. Lngst ned visas totalt belopp p interimskontot fr angivet avstmningsdatum.
Observera att den hr informationen ocks kan hmtas genom att skriva ut rapporten Avstmning LR - RE, avrkningskonto frn programmet Utskrift avstmning LR - HP (bavstlr). Rapporten gller dock endast till slutet av redovisningsperioderna och inte ngot angivet datum.

### Aktuella funktionsknappar/berknade flt

#### **Skapa avstmningsposter** [(Knapp/flt: PB\_APClAcctRecon\_CreRcds)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_PB_APClAcctRecon_CreRcds.HTM)

Funktionen fr att skapa poster i arbetstabellen fr avstmning av avrkningskontot och huvudboken p skrmen.
Nr du trycker p knappen stlls en kontrollfrga om du verkligen vill skapa posterna. Funktionen rensar bort eventuellt gammalt innehll i arbetstabellen och skapar nya data i tabellen, d.v.s. fakturorna ligger kvar i arbetstabellen till nsta gng du trycker p knappen.
Om du svarar Ja blir du ombedd att ange fr vilket datum beloppet p interimskontot ska berknas. Nr funktionen r klar kan du ska efter fakturor fr avstmning.  
  

2 Ny kolumn i tabellen Fakturor, betalningsservice
--------------------------------------------------

En ny kolumn End2End-id (End2EndId) har lagts till i tabellen Fakturor, betalningsservice (lrfb). End2End-id r ett unikt nummer som r en kombination av datum och tid. Det uppdateras under skapandet av SEPA-filen och anvnds fr att identifiera leverantrsfakturor vid import av bankfilerna CAMT053 och CAMT054.
Det hr vrdet kan ocks visas i den inbddade listan i Fakturabetalningsservice (xjfbs).
Observera att den hr ndringen endast gller leverantrsbetalningar.  



3 Flt fr rapporteringsenhet tillagt i ytterligare tabeller
----------------------------------------------------------

Fltet Rapporteringsenhet (rptunitno) har lagts till i fljande tabeller fr att skerstlla transparens i transaktioner och spra arbetsflden till slutfrande:
- Bestllning, huvud (bh)
- Bestllningsrader (bp)
- Inleveranser, bestllningsrader (bpi)
- Erhllna bestllningar ->HB (bpiv)

1 ndring av namn p kontodelsflt
-------------------------------

Namnen p interna kontodelsflt har ndrats genom att ta bort ordet Faktura i brjan. ndringarna terspeglas i programmen Produktkonton (Xartpk) och Konteringsmallar, tjnstekonton (Ptko) enligt fljande:

2 Std fr momsdeklarationer i Norge baserat p SAF-T-kodformat
------------------------------------------------------------

Som en del av de norska myndigheternas arbete med att gra all beskattning digital, mste momsrapporter lmnas in baserat p SAF-T-kodformatet. Den nya momsrapporten r i XML-format och bygger p kodlistan Standard Audit File for Tax (SAF-T), vilket gr den mer specificerad n den tidigare, summerade momsrapporten (30 mot 19 rader). Detta r ett juridiskt krav som ska fljas och anvndas av alla kunder frn och med januari 2022.
Jeeves har infrt std och automatisering enligt beskrivningen i fljande avsnitt fr att hjlpa kunder efterleva de nya kraven.  

### **2.1 Nya program och flt fr att definiera momsrapportrader i deklarationsfilen**

### **Norsk momsrapport** [(Program: NOVATRpt)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_NOVATRpt.HTM)

Definition av momsrapportrader som kan anvndas fr att skapa en en-till-en identifiering av vilka data som rapporteras och med vilken SAF-T-momskod i XML-utdatafilen.
Rapportraderna r samma som i listan med momssatser, men kan ha separata rader fr indata- och utdataposter. Exempelvis kan momskoden 386 kopplad till den norska SAF-T-koden 86 ha separata indata- och utdatarader i utdatafilen enligt denna definition. Varje post hr representerar en rad i momsdeklarationen fr Norge.
De momsrapportrader som definieras hr tilldelas till momscellbeskrivningarna (BE\_VAT\_Box).
Nr du skapar momsrapporten med knappen Skapa momsrapportunderlag (PB\_Create\_VAT\_BE), hmtas momsrapportraderna till fljande tabeller/program:
- Momsrapportunderlag, detaljer (BE\_Vat\_Amt)
- Momsrapportunderlag, totaler (BE\_VAT\_Total)

Mer information om att mappa Jeeves-data fr norsk momsdeklaration baserat p SAF-T-kodformatet finns i det relevanta avsnittet i kapitlet Arbeta med integrationspaket.
Du kan visa status fr paketen som skickats till molnagenten fr bearbetning, inklusive XML-innehll som returneras av molnagenten, i noden Integrationskhistorik som ppnas via programmet Momsrapporteringsperioder (taxperiods).
- Om information har lagts till i kn:
-- uppdateras fltet Dokument-id automatiskt med nsta tillgngliga nummer i serien och dokumentstatusen uppdateras med vrdet Paket kat i programmet Momsrapporteringsperioder (taxperiods).
-- skapas en post i programmet Integrationsdokument med dokumentstatus satt till 60, Paket kat och en post med kstatus 40, Tillagd i kn skapas i integrationsdokumentets statuslogg.
-- skapas en post med kstatusen Tillagd i kn i programmet Integrationsk vilket ppnas som en nod i programmet Integrationspaket. Klicka p knappen Integr kparametrar fr att ppna texteditorn och se Internt fretagsnummer, Redovisningsr, Momsperiod (VATtaxperiod), Korrigeringsnummer (VATtaxcorrectionno) och numret fr Momsrapporteringsenheter (RptUnit) som r kopplade till integrationspaketet.
-- lggs ven en post med kstatusen Tillagd i kn till i integrationspaketets kstatuslogg vilken ppnas som en nod i programmet Integrationspaket.
-- nr molnagenten lser fakturan och skapar XML-innehll, visas det hr innehllet i textfltet i noden Integrationsk. Om ett dokument-id finns tillgngligt visas ven detta i programmet Integrationsdokument. Dessutom stts dokumentstatusen till 10, Ny (XML skapad) i programmet Momsrapporteringsperioder och integrationsdokumentets statuslogg.
Nr molnagenten har behandlat det kade integrationspaketet, returnerar den integrationspaketets kstatus.
- Om den returnerade statusen r 900, Bekrftad:
-- uppdateras fltet Dokumentstatus med vrdet Skickat i programmet Momsregistreringsperioder.
-- stts statusen fr dokumentet till 40, Skickad i programmet Integrationsdokument och en ny post skapas i noden Statuslogg fr integrationsdokument.
-- tas den relevanta posten bort frn integrationskn och flyttas till programmet Integreringskhistorik (som ppnas som en nod frn programmet Momsrapporteringsperioder) med kstatus fr Integrationspaket satt till Bekrftat. Den hr posten innehller XML-innehllet som returneras av molnagenten. Observera att nr detta r frdigt visas tv poster i programmet Integreringskhistorik, en med kstatus fr Integrationspaket satt till Tillagd i kn och den andra med med statusen Bekrftat.
-- en post med statusen Bekrftat lggs ocks till i integrationspaketets kstatuslogg. I den hr noden kan du se orsaken till den status som skickas frn molnagenten i texteditorn.
- Om den returnerade statusen r 910, Misslyckat:
-- uppdateras fltet Dokumentstatus med vrdet Sndningsfel i programmet Momsregistreringsperioder.
-- stts statusen fr dokumentet till 50 i programmet Integrationsdokument och en ny post med statusen Sndningsfel skapas i integrationsdokumentets statuslogg.
-- tas den relevanta posten bort frn
integrationskn och flyttas till programmet Integreringskhistorik (som ppnas som en nod frn programmet Momsrapporteringsperioder) med kstatus fr Integrationspaket satt till Misslyckat. Den hr posten innehller XML-innehllet som returneras av molnagenten. Observera att nr detta r frdigt visas tv poster i programmet Integreringskhistorik, en med kstatus fr Integrationspaket satt till Tillagd i kn och den andra med med statusen Misslyckat.
-- en post med statusen Misslyckat lggs ocks till i integrationspaketets kstatuslogg. I den hr noden kan du se orsaken till den status som skickas frn molnagenten i texteditorn.

[1 ndrad logik i funktionen verfr till Lr PDM](#section1)

    :   [3 Frbttrad logik i Skapa betalningsfil](#section3)

  

1 ndrad logik i funktionen verfr till Lr PDM
--------------------------------------------

I tidigare versioner stoppades verfringen av samtliga poster vid verfring av fakturagranskningsposterna om ett fel hittades i en enskild post. Logiken har nu ndrats enligt nedanstende beskrivning.  

### Aktuella funktionsknappar/berknade flt

#### **verfr till Lr - PDM** [(Knapp/flt: PB\_Create\_Lr\_PDM)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_PB_Create_Lr_PDM.HTM)

Funktion fr verfring av granskade leverantrsfakturor till leverantrsreskontra. Funktionen tar med alla fakturor som r granskade men nnu inte verfrda.  
  
Vid verfring kontrolleras fakturagranskningsposterna automatiskt, en i taget. Alla giltiga poster omvandlas till leverantrsfakturor och verfrs till leverantrsfakturatabellen (lr) och leverantrsreskontran. Om det finns ett fel i ngon post omvandlas denna post inte till en faktura. Nr alla poster har behandlats visa ett meddelande med verfringsstatus som liknar exemplet nedan:  
 PvlrID = 52 MED FEL  
 PvlrID = 53 BEHANDLAT  
 PvlrID = 54 BEHANDLAT  
 verfringsstatusen uppdateras ven i fltet Text/info 2 (x255\_2) i tabellen/programmet Granskning av importerad leverantrsfaktura (pvlr). Vid fel visas ven det tillhrande felmeddelandet i fltet. Fr alla poster som visas med felstatus behver du korrigera felet och upprepa verfringen genom att klicka p funktionen igen.  
  
Vid verfring skapas en dokumentpost i EDM-tabellen som i sin tur skapar en attestkedja i Jeeves Workflow.  
  
Nr en frskottsfaktura, kredit (fakturatyp 2) verfrs till leverantrsreskontra skapas tv godknnandeposter enligt fljande fr att frskottsfakturan ska visas i att gra-listan i Workflow (todolist1):  
 - En post fr ankomstattest utan verifikation   
 - En under attest-post med en verifikation frn mallen som har kopplats till leverantrsfakturatypen.   
 Observera att den konteringsmall som r knuten till frskottsfakturakrediten (a conto) behver ha atteststatusen satt till Under attest.  
  

2 Endtoendid tillagd i fler program
-----------------------------------

Endtoendid r en unik identifieringsnyckel som skickas vidare i ofrndrad form genom hela den obrutna betalningskedjan fr leverantrsfakturan och kan visas i den inbddade listan Kontoutdrag i programmet Bankkontoutdrag, allmn import (bstmt\_header) samt den inbddade listan fr utbetalningsdetaljer i programmet Kvittenser utbetalningar (lrkh)  



3 Frbttrad logik i Skapa betalningsfil
--------------------------------------

Om debet- och kreditkontot inte omfattas av Nordeas Global Cash Pool-tjnst behandlas betalningen som en vanlig betalning mellan fretag. Om du vill aktivera behandlingen av betalningen som en Global Cash Pool-verfring som inte ger ngon ytterligare bankavgift kan du nu ange koden SDVA i fltet fr SEPA-kategorindaml (sepa\_ctgypurp) i programmet Utbetalningsvgar (x2uv) p fljande stt: INTC;SDVA (avgrnsat med semikolon). I det hr fallet ses SDVA som serviceniv nr betalningsfilen behandlas och bankavgiften inte tas ut. Annars anses det befintliga vrdet (NURG eller SEPA) som serviceniv nr betalningsfilen behandlas.

# doc_980.htm

Multifretag, sl ihop databaser

###### Systemadmin. och utveckling / Flerfretagshantering / - (980)

Multifretag, sl ihop databaser
==============================

###### Jeeves version Application Services (JAS) 8.5 Kapitelrevision 0

  

Beskrivningen av funktion fr att sl ihop flera databaser till en databas samt att anvnda multifretagshanteringen i den nya databasen.  
Frst mste du utse den databas som ska finnas kvar och som de vriga databaserna ska kopierias in i Instllningarna (site repository) i den databasen blir den som sedan kommer att anvndas fr alla fretagen.  
Instllningarna kopieras INTE ver frn de vriga databaserna. Detta gller ven tabeller som sy2 (inloggningar) , sy3 (restriktionsvyer), workflow, menyer, ....  
Kopiering grs endast av tabeller som innehller kolumnen fretagkod (OBS!!! Detta kan innebra att ven icke Jeevestabeller som du sjlv har skapat kommer med i bearbetningen).  
  
Du br (skall) brja med att se till att fretagskoden i den databas som ska behllas INTE har 0 som kod.  
Nr man enbart har ett fretag i en databas r det vldigt bekvmt att anvnda fretagskod 0 eftersom detta stts automatiskt om fretagskoden inte anges vid skapande av nya poster.  
Vid flerfretag blir detta i stllet en felklla. Ngot som skulle in p fretag 10 hamnar p fretag 0 om du glmmer att ange fretagskod och d r det ju bra att det hamnar p ett fretag som inte finns samt att regelverket i databasen vgrar att ta emot posten.  
  
Fr att ndra fretagkoden kr fljande frn query analyzer:

**This chapter is only provided in English.**

Jeeves includes extensive functionality for adding own modifications and development. Here follow some examples:  
  
- You can add your own tables, views, windows and programs to Jeeves and also make fields from your own tables available in standard form windows.  
 - Tables and views must be created in the database along with primary key, indexes and defaults.  
 - Own programs can display information from Jeeves' tables and views or own tables and views.  
 - Own programs can consist of an unlimited number of levels with embedded list windows and/or underlying program nodes. They can also be used as embedded lists and nodes in Jeeves' standard programs.  
 - You can make own windows and checkoff (left-right list)-windows  
 - You can make total windows in your own programs  
 - You can choose which fields to display in the form and/or list, and how to display: drop-down lists, show fields as a checkboxes  
 - You can choose if your program allows insert, update and or delete  
 - You can also add Jeeves standard nodes to other standard nodes  
 - You can create right-clicks in standard Jeeves programs as well as in own programs  
 - You can create drop-down lists in own programs based on standard or own data.  
 - Drop-down lists based on own tables can be translated and displayed in the relevant language when you switch language in the client.  
  
If you use Jeeves programs to hold own programs, windows, views, tables, connections, constraints, own database SQL objects (added, replaced or subtags), this can be used as a form of documentation of your adaptations. Most of the objects can also be a part of an own app.  
  
Managing own modifications in database logic  
 - You can use subtags (subtags are tagged own code to be placed in existing location tags in our standard code) to modify standard database SQL objects such as procedures, triggers, views and database functions.  
 - Note that the subtag must be placed in a location tag in the object. If location tag is missing we, Jeeves Information Systems, must add it in our standard code. Otherwise it will disappear after upgrading.  
 - If subtags are entered in the intended program and an upgrade takes place, the subtags are re-installed in the database automatically. However, if you install fixes manually or by JvsSQLRun, you must remember to re-install subtags manually in this program. You can use the same program for own added or replaced standard procedures, triggers, views, database functions and table functions. In this program there are nodes for history regarding whole objects and subtags  
 - The program with content can be used as a documentation of own adaptations of modified standard code (in subtags) as well as own or replaced triggers, procedures views etc.  
 - You can add own language managed texts to be used by macros and own SQL code  
  
This chapter describes some of the tools for making modifications in Jeeves and how to make modifications upgradeable.  
  
**Note!**  
 - You are not allowed to modify standard Jeeves code in the database or files.  
  
- If you create an app you must store the source code in Jeeves' programs/tables for customization (their names start with the prefix "UsrDef" which stands for User defined). By doing so, you make information about your modifications, which is valuable to customers and consultants, visible within Jeeves.  
  
- In order to avoid conflicts with Jeeves standard and own apps, you must follow Jeeves Information Systems' name convention for names of all non-standard objects (tables, terms, connections, programs, subtags, macros etc) within all own modifications.  
  
**Extended name convention:**  
 -----------------------------------------  
 Unique name q\_A\_B\_C where:  
 q\_ = Is used to differentiate it from Jeeves standard. This prefix is already used and it is well established within the Jeeves sphere.   
 A = Your partner ID. NOTE! Before use you must check with us that the ID is ok and not already taken. Send an e-mail to support@jeeves.se.  
 B = Branch/vertical/app, a suitable name of your choice.   
 C = Name of your own developed object, e.g. an added term, table, macro, trigger, sub tag, database object, program etc.  
  
The ID can only consist of combinations of A-Z , 0-9 and \_.  
  
Example: q\_JIS\_Service\_itemclass   
  
Partners must also make sure that their IDs are unique within their own organization.  

1 Audience
----------

This chapter, like the other chapters in this folder, is for system consultants and developers qualified in SQL Server and with knowledge of Jeeves' technical structure.  
  
All persons who make own modifications and development in Jeeves should also attend Jeeves' training on the subject, where recommended practices are also discussed.  



2 Introduction
--------------

### **2.1 Unicode vs non Unicode in own development**

It is crucial to keep these differences in mind if you develop in a non Unicode environment and export to a Unicode environment, or vice versa.  
  
Tables  
 ----------  
 - Tables created as Unicode will remain Unicode when imported to a non Unicode environment.  
 - Tables created as non Unicode will remain non Unicode when imported to a Unicode environment.  
 - **Joins between Unicode and non Unicode tables will result in performance problems in non Unicode environments  
 - You will have functional problems in Unicode environments if you store Unicode signs in non Unicode tables  
 - Note that terms added within Jeeves in a Unicode environment will be Unicode terms**  
  
Currently suggested solution:   
 - Make separate apps for Unicode and non Unicode  
 - Create tables via scripts instead of adding them in the Apps builder's embedded list for tables  
 - Check whether or not the database is Unicode and then create tables accordingly, Unicode or non Unicode  
  
Own database objects as procedures, triggers etc.  
 ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
  
- Use Jeeves standard data types in own procedures, triggers, sub tags etc.  
  
- Use Jeeves\_StrVarchar data type instead of varchar and nvarchar (Jeeves\_StrVarChar to Jeeves\_StrVarChar 4000 and Max). Mixing nvarchar and varchar will lead to performance problems. This also makes it easier to handle Unicode/non Unicode systems and changes to terms. You will find more complete information in the jvstype.sql file, found in the application directory, under the section "UNICODE".   
  
Note that this will not work with the SQL functions: CAST or CONVERT, where you must use nchar and nvarchar.  
  
Temporary tables created in procedures, triggers or sub tags  
 -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------  
You can create a temporary table with our Jeeves\_Add\_cols\_To\_temp\_table procedure, which creates temporary tables in a correct way. Parameters: temptable, sourcetable, columnlist. Example:  

![NULL](981_ex_create_temp_table.gif)
  
  
Below we show an example of code for checking if the database is Unicode or non Unicode, and for creating a temporary table in order to make a join:  

![NULL](981_ex_check_unicode.gif)

### **2.2 Overview of development tools and work flow**

![NULL](981_overview.gif)

### **Related texts**

![NULL](981_overview_texts.gif)

### **Overview of work flow when creating own programs**

This section gives a brief description of the work flow when creating own programs. The steps are described in detail in the following sections.  
  
1) Create a table or view in the database. Default, primary key and indexes to tables are created in the database. For standard terms use our data types.  
  
2) Add own terms in Jeeves.  
  
3) Add your program in Own programs, using the same program name as its table name.  
  
4) Right-click to Own windows, add the same window name and check Def, show all form fields and Def, show all list-fields.  
  
5) From Own windows, right-click to Own tables and add the table name.  
  
6) Add the primary key in the left embedded list. You must also add primary keys for views.  
  
7) Add contraints in the right list.  
  
8) Press ESC back to Own windows and save the window record.  
  
9) Reload the window to the form and press ESC back to Own programs and save the program record. Now it is possible to right-click from the program to the table.  
  
10) Restart Jeeves.  
  
11) Start your new, own program (to load Fields in own windows (UsrDefWindowFields)).  
  
12) Go to the Fields in own windows program (UsrDefWindowFields) and change the appearance of the fields, if necessary.  

### **2.3 Own programs**

You can create own programs:  
 - to display data from Jeeves' or own tables  
 - to display data from Jeeves' or own views  
 - with Jeeves standard windows or own windows  
 - with several levels in the form of nodes or embedded list windows  
 - as nodes or embedded lists in Jeeves standard programs  
  
Always follow the name convention described above!  
  
Store as much of your own modifications and development as you can in Jeeves programs. All the definitions in Jeeves programs are included when exporting, or building apps, and this automatically provides "documentation" of your own modifications and development.  
  
You must define own programs in Jeeves and, in the definition, specify the name of the program so that it can be added to and started from the menu.  
  
Via Jeeves' Tools menu you can add fields from other tables to own programs/forms, both from your own tables and from Jeeves' tables, if there is a connection/link.  

### **2.4 Own tables**

You define own tables by building them yourself in the database. When you create tables, information about the tables is stored in the server's system tables. When Jeeves uses your tables, the server's system tables are used to retrieve column names and references to other tables.  
  
The name of the table cannot contain special characters (,,, #, !, ?, etc). Jeeves' mandatory name convention is described in the beginning of this chapter!  
  
You can also use a database view, but you must then add fields to related tables in the view.  
  
In the case of normal tables, you can add links to other tables and include fields from these tables in your form.  

### **2.5 Columns/fields in own tables**

Columns in own tables can be Jeeves standard terms or own terms added via Jeeves' Tools menu. Note that if you use Jeeves standard terms, you must use the same data type.

3 Create a table in the database
--------------------------------

You create own tables or views in the database for example via SQL Server management studio. Always define primary keys, indexes and database defaults. Remember:  
  
- For any standard terms use Jeeves' data type.  
 - If own terms add them in Jeeves and save to a default all users group.  
 - Do not use SQL identity if the table is a part of an own app or is to be replicated.

4 Create and add own terms in Jeeves
------------------------------------

Use the Add (create), Terms option on the Tools menu.  

  
 Click on the link below if you need more information about the Tools menu.  

### [**Settings on the Tools menu**](ms-its:DocAreas_SE.chm::/doc_1017.HTM)

### **4.1 How to make fields from own tables available in Jeeves standard forms**

If you want to make fields from an own table available in a standard form, for example make fields from q\_JIS\_CompanyType available in Jeeves' standard Customers form, you must define a constraint from the Customers table (kus) to the q\_JIS\_CompanyType table in UsrDefConstraints.  
  
Then add the field to the standard Customers form window by using the Add field in form tool.
  
  

![NULL](981_usrdefconstraints.gif)

5 Define program and window, and connect to table
-------------------------------------------------

Below we describe the recommended way of defining own programs. (How to define tables and views in the database is described above.)  
  
As an alternative, you can just define the program name in Own programs (usrdefprogram), on condition that the window and table names are identical to the program name. If you do so, only the key will exist in your program so you will need to add all other fields to the form via the Tools menu. If you use this alternative you must create your table in the database with primary key and constraints/links. Avoid constraints in the database if you can; they can cause problems when upgrading. Add constraints in UsrDefConstraints instead.  

### **5.1 Define program**

### **Own programs** [(Program: UsrDefProgram)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_UsrDefProgram.HTM)

Definition of own programs which you have added and which are not included in Jeeves standard.  
  
It is always easiest to name a program and associated table with the same name. Then you only need to enter a record in this table with content in the Program name and Program description fields. If the program and table names are NOT the same, you must also fill in the field for window name and define the window name and the name for your own table in the Own tables (UsrDefTable) or Own windows (UsrDefWindow) program.  
  
In the underlying program node - Own nodes in own programs - you can define an unlimited number of underlying program nodes and/or embedded list windows, either your own or from Jeeves standard. In addition to defining the node structure, you must define the relationship between the tables being used (constraints) for each node/window. You can also define a right-click to other programs in your own nodes and own defaults when making new entries in the nodes.  
   
 Records may not visible in the embedded list of a user-defined node because of the customized form design in the Desktop client. You must manually add columns into embedded list(s) so that the columns are bound to the data and thereby made visible in the own nodes.  
   
 The program also includes functions for export and import of own programs, but export/import via the Apps builder is recommended since it automatically provides documentation of all included customizations (see the chapter about Jeeves Apps builder).

#### Relevant/important field(s)/button(s):

##### **Program name in Jeeves** [(Field:: JvsProgramName)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_JvsProgramName.HTM)

The name (internal data name) for a program you have added. This must be a unique name that does not exist in Jeeves standard. If there is already a program with the same name in Jeeves, your program will not start.  
  
 Mandatory name convention:  
 -----------------------------------------  
 Unique name q\_A\_B\_C where:  
 q\_ = Is used to differentiate it from Jeeves standard. This prefix is already used and it is well established within the Jeeves sphere.   
 A = Your partner ID. NOTE! Before use you must check with us that the ID is ok and not already taken. Send an e-mail to support@jeeves.se.  
 B = Branch/vertical/app, a suitable name of your choice.   
 C = Name of your own developed object, e.g. an added term, table, macro, trigger, sub tag, database object, program etc.  
  
The ID can only consist of combinations of A-Z , 0-9 and \_.  
  
 Example: q\_JIS\_Service\_itemclass   
  
Partners must also make sure that their IDs are unique within their own organization.  
  

##### **Program descr in Jeeves** [(Field:: JvsProgramDescription)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_JvsProgramDescription.HTM)

Brief description of a program you have added yourself. This will display in the program menu if you do not specify a description there when you insert the program in the menu.  
  

##### **Window name in Jeeves** [(Field:: JvsWindowName)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_JvsWindowName.HTM)

Name (internal data name) for a window you have added yourself. This must be a unique name that does not exist in Jeeves standard. Alternatively, use a window in Jeeves standard.  
  

### **5.2 Right-click and define window**

### **Own windows** [(Program: UsrDefWindow)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_UsrDefWindow.HTM)

Definition of own windows in own programs, including information about which table or view your window will use. This can be a Jeeves table or view, but normally it is an own table or view which does not exist in Jeeves standard.

![NULL](981_usrdefwindows.gif)

#### Relevant/important field(s)/button(s):

##### **Window name in Jeeves** [(Field:: JvsWindowName)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_JvsWindowName.HTM)

Name (internal data name) for a window you have added yourself. This must be a unique name that does not exist in Jeeves standard. Alternatively, use a window in Jeeves standard.  
  

##### **Window descr in Jeeves** [(Field:: JvsWindowDescription)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_JvsWindowDescription.HTM)

Brief description of a window that can be used by Jeeves. This can be a Jeeves standard window or a custom window from own development.  
  

##### **Table name** [(Field:: JvsTableName)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_JvsTableName.HTM)

Name (internal data name) of a database table or view that can be used by Jeeves. We recommend that you use the same name for tables as for associated programs.  
  
 Mandatory name convention:  
 -----------------------------------------  
 Unique name q\_A\_B\_C where:  
 q\_ = Is used to differentiate it from Jeeves standard. This prefix is already used and it is well established within the Jeeves sphere.   
 A = Your partner ID. NOTE! Before use you must check with us that the ID is ok and not already taken. Send an e-mail to support@jeeves.se.  
 B = Branch/vertical/app, a suitable name of your choice.   
 C = Name of your own developed object, e.g. an added term, table, macro, trigger, sub tag, database object, program etc.  
  
The ID can only consist of combinations of A-Z , 0-9 and \_.  
  
Example: q\_JIS\_Service\_itemclass   
  
Partners must also make sure that their IDs are unique within their own organization.  
  

##### **Def, show all form fields** [(Field:: usrdefwindowformshowall)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_usrdefwindowformshowall.HTM)

If checked (true) all fields from the table are displayed in the form.  
  
If this box is checked the first time you start the new program, or if you have added terms to your table or view, all the fields in your table or view will be visible and you do not need to add them via Tools/Add field in form/list. All fields are also loaded into the Fields in own windows node (UsrDefWindowFields) where you can hide/show them or change their appearance.   
  

##### **Def, show all list fields** [(Field:: usrdefwindowlistshowall)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_usrdefwindowlistshowall.HTM)

If checked (or Y) all fields from the table are displayed in the list.  
  
If this box is checked the first time you start the new program, or if you have added terms to your table or view, all the fields in your table or view will be visible and you do not need to add them via Tools/Add field in form/list. All fields are also loaded into the Fields in own windows node (UsrDefWindowFields) where you can hide/show them or change their appearance.  
  

##### **Insert allowed** [(Field:: usrdefwindowinsertallowed)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_usrdefwindowinsertallowed.HTM)

By default, users are allowed to insert data in all fields in own tables. Uncheck this checkbox to disallow insertions for the field in question.  
  

##### **Update allowed** [(Field:: usrdefwindowupdateallowed)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_usrdefwindowupdateallowed.HTM)

By default, users are allowed to update data in all fields in own tables. Uncheck this checkbox to disallow updates for the field in question.  
  

##### **Delete allowed** [(Field:: usrdefwindowdeleteallowed)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_usrdefwindowdeleteallowed.HTM)

By default, users are allowed to delete data in all fields in own tables. Uncheck this checkbox to disallow deletions for the field in question.  
  

##### **Form window table func** [(Field:: jvsformwindowtfname)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_jvsformwindowtfname.HTM)

Name of table function used to load form window in users' own defined programs.  
  
For example shopfloor form window:  
  
Jeeves\_TF\_uAoToDo\_Form  
  

##### **Form window TF args** [(Field:: jvsformwindowtfargs)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_jvsformwindowtfargs.HTM)

Arguments to a table function used to load form window in user own defined program.  
  
For example arguments to shopfloor form window:  
  
"<%.uaotodo>.<%ForetagKod>, '<%.sy2>.<%PersSign>', <%.\_\_func>.<%UF\_Get\_LangCd>, <%.uaotodo>.<%AoNr>, <%.uaotodo>.<%AoPos>, <%.uaotodo>.<%OpNr>, '<%.uaotodo>.<%ProdGr>"  
  

##### **List window table func** [(Field:: jvslistwindowtfname)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_jvslistwindowtfname.HTM)

Name of table function used to load list window in user own defined program.  
  
For example list window in shopfloor:  
  
 Jeeves\_TF\_uAoToDo\_List   
  

##### **List window TF args** [(Field:: jvslistwindowtfargs)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_jvslistwindowtfargs.HTM)

Arguments to a table function used to load list window in user own defined program.  
  
For example arguments to shopfloor list window:  
  
"<%.sy1>.<%ForetagKod>, N'<%.sy2>.<%PersSign>', <%.\_\_func>.<%UF\_Get\_LangCd>, <%.\_\_func>.<%UF\_Get\_JobCardNo>"  
  

### **5.3 Right-click and define view or table**

### **Own tables** [(Program: UsrDefTable)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_UsrDefTable.HTM)

Definition of own tables and views that you have created in the database for Jeeves to access. You can also add standard tables to create new constraints.  
  
Here there is also a node for defining own columns in standard views in Jeeves.  
  
In the Language management node you can specify that table is to be included in language management via the CustomerDropDown table, by defining the column in the table that should be possible to translate. If this functionality is in use, and you update, insert or delete a record in the base table, i.e. your own table, CustomerDropDown must be updated. If you press the Genereate trigger button, SQL code is generated and displayed in the Edit field. You can use the code to create your own triggers for this purpose for the table.

Name (internal data name) of a database table or view that can be used by Jeeves. We recommend that you use the same name for tables as for associated programs.

 B = Branch/vertical/app, a suitable name of your choice.   
 C = Name of your own developed object, e.g. an added term, table, macro, trigger, sub tag, database object, program etc.  
  
The ID can only consist of combinations of A-Z , 0-9 and \_.  
  
Example: q\_JIS\_Service\_itemclass   
  
Partners must also make sure that their IDs are unique within their own organization.  
  

##### **Table description** [(Field:: JvsTableDescription)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_JvsTableDescription.HTM)

Brief description of a table that can be used by Jeeves.

### **5.5 In left embedded list, define primary keys**

### **Primary keys in own tables** [(Table: usrdeftablespkcolumns)](ms-its:Tables_SE.chm::/tbd_usrdeftablespkcolumns.HTM)

Definition of primary keys in own tables and views that you have created in the database.

##### **Sequence No.** [(Field:: jvsseqno)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_jvsseqno.HTM)

##### **Column name** [(Field:: jvscolumnname)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_jvscolumnname.HTM)

### **5.6 In right embedded list, define constraints**

### **Own links/relationships between tables** [(Program: usrdefconstraints)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_usrdefconstraints.HTM)

Definition of relationships between tables/windows in own programs.  
  
The constraints you define here must be ManyTo1 (Mto1) as in Jeeves TBD files. Keep in mind that FromTable\_1toM\_ToTable is always ToTable\_Mto1\_FromTable.  
  
In multicompany installations you must define a restriction with a Mto1 relationship to the Sy1 table and with the Company (foretagkod) column.  
  
You can specify a standard table and add a relationship to an own table, if required.

#### Relevant/important field(s)/button(s):

##### **Constraint** [(Field:: jvsconstraintname)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_jvsconstraintname.HTM)

Name of constraint according to own definition. Normally a constraint requires a match, but if you name the constraint with the suffix "\_NoCheck", no check will be performed.  
  
 Example: q\_JIS\_CompanyType\_Mto1\_kus\_Nocheck  
  

##### **Relation to table** [(Field:: jvsconstraintreftable)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_jvsconstraintreftable.HTM)

The dataname of the To-table in the relationship, can be a Jeeves standard table or an own table.  
  

##### **Right-click to program** [(Field:: jvsconstraintrefprogram)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_jvsconstraintrefprogram.HTM)

The dataname of the program to be used in the relationship, can be a Jeeves standard program or an own program.

### **Own links/relationships between tables, columns** [(Table: usrdefconstraintcolumns)](ms-its:Tables_SE.chm::/tbd_usrdefconstraintcolumns.HTM)

Definition of key columns in related tables/windows in customized programs.  
  
Foreign key column and references key column must be defined for each table/window. They can be different column names.

### **Columns in own tables** [(Table: UsrDefTableColumns)](ms-its:Tables_SE.chm::/tbd_UsrDefTableColumns.HTM)

Can be used to add a column in a standard view. Note that the logic in the view must also be changed, using sub tags.

### **5.9 In node to Own windows, modify window fields**

### **Fields in own windows** [(Program: usrdefwindowfields)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_usrdefwindowfields.HTM)

Definition of the fields to be included in customized windows for customized tables.
  
When starting your own program the first time this program/table will be loaded with all columns from your table. Here you can choose if the columns should be visible in the different windows (form, list, total) and their appearance; checkbox, drop-down.  

![NULL](981_usrdefwindowfields.gif)

#### Relevant/important field(s)/button(s):

##### **Sequence No.** [(Field:: jvsseqno)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_jvsseqno.HTM)

Sequence number of own nodes, columns, fields etc.  
  

##### **Table name** [(Field:: jvstablename)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_jvstablename.HTM)

Name (internal data name) of a database table or view that can be used by Jeeves. We recommend that you use the same name for tables as for associated programs.  
  
 Mandatory name convention:  
 -----------------------------------------  
 Unique name q\_A\_B\_C where:  
 q\_ = Is used to differentiate it from Jeeves standard. This prefix is already used and it is well established within the Jeeves sphere.   
 A = Your partner ID. NOTE! Before use you must check with us that the ID is ok and not already taken. Send an e-mail to support@jeeves.se.  
 B = Branch/vertical/app, a suitable name of your choice.   
 C = Name of your own developed object, e.g. an added term, table, macro, trigger, sub tag, database object, program etc.  
  
The ID can only consist of combinations of A-Z , 0-9 and \_.  
  
Example: q\_JIS\_Service\_itemclass   
  
Partners must also make sure that their IDs are unique within their own organization.  
  

##### **Column name** [(Field:: jvscolumnname)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_jvscolumnname.HTM)

Name (internal data name) of a column in a database table that is used by Jeeves. (Used for different purposes in different applications.)  
  

##### **Displayed in form** [(Field:: usrdeffieldoutonform)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_usrdeffieldoutonform.HTM)

If checked (or Y) the field is displayed in the form.  
  

##### **Displayed in list window** [(Field:: usrdeffieldoutonlist)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_usrdeffieldoutonlist.HTM)

If checked (or Y) the field is displayed in the list window.  
  

##### **Displayed in total window** [(Field:: usrdeffieldoutontotal)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_usrdeffieldoutontotal.HTM)

If checked (or Y) the field is displayed in the total window.  
  

##### **Drop down list** [(Field:: usrdeffieldasdropdownlist)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_usrdeffieldasdropdownlist.HTM)

If checked (or Y) the field is displayed as a drop-down list.  
  

##### **Drop-down value column** [(Field:: usrdefdropdownvaluecolumn)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_usrdefdropdownvaluecolumn.HTM)

If the field is to be displayed as a drop-down list, specify from which column (the code or the description) the value in the drop-down list is to be retrieved. A constraint between the tables must exist in Own tables (UsrDefTables).  
  
Note! In later versions you should use the drop-down list checkbox and the drop-down value column field in the Fields in own windows program (UsrDefWindowFields) instead of using this field in Own links/relationships between tables (UsrDefConstraints).  
  

##### **Show as checkbox** [(Field:: usrdeffieldascheckbox)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_usrdeffieldascheckbox.HTM)

If checked (or Y) the field is displayed as a checkbox.

6 Example of own program with underlying nodes and views
--------------------------------------------------------

**Note that this is an example originally created in an earlier version, which is why parts of it do not follow Jeeves' extended name convention described in various sections in this chapter.**  
  
Own programs can consist of an unlimited number of levels of embedded list windows and/or underlying program nodes.  

### **6.1 Diagram of the node structure in the example**

The program in our example shows invoicing statistics on different levels. The overlying node A shows invoicing per customer, fiscal year and period.  
  
There are two underlying program nodes for this:  
  
- AA displays the statistics in node A broken down per item. Node AA also has underlying program nodes in several levels.  
  
- AB shows the underlying invoice rows for the statistics in node A.  

![NULL](981_NodeDiagr.gif)

### **6.2 Definition of the node structure in Jeeves**

The definition of the program is shown below. We can access the definition of the node structure for the program via Own nodes in own programs.  

![NULL](981_usrdefprogram_a.gif)
  
   
 You can see the node structure we have described in the list in the window below. In the form you can see the definition of node, and in the embedded list window the definition of the underlying nodes AA and AB.  
  
The underlying program nodes AAA and AAAA are defined in a corresponding manner.  

![NULL](981_usrdefprogram_aa.gif)
  
   
 Below we show how you can link in a program and use the program's node structure. This example shows how it is possible to continue to the Jeeves standard program for displaying voucher rows from the invoice rows in node AAA and thereby gain access to the standard nodes in the program.  

![NULL](981_UsrDefProgram_aa2.gif)

### **6.5 Definition of the relationships between the tables**

In addition to defining the node structure, you must define the relationship between the tables being used (constraints) for each node/window. This is done in the Own tables program (Usrdeftable) which is reached by right-clicking in the field for the node's window name and then right-clicking in the field for the table name.  
  
The definition for the window/table kus\_ar\_ft\_per\_view is displayed below, which is used in node AA in our example. Besides linking to Jeeves standard tables Company (fr) and Items (ar) from which the statistics are retrieved, the relationship to the overlying window kus\_ft\_per\_view must be defined.

7 Alternative program for linking programs as nodes
---------------------------------------------------

### 7.1 **Own nodes** [(Program: UsrDefAddedNodes)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_UsrDefAddedNodes.HTM)

Definition of own nodes to programs, both to Jeeves' standard programs and to own programs. Normally, however, you use this program to add own programs as nodes in Jeeves' standard programs. There is another program you can use to add nodes to own programs, which is accessed via Own programs (program: usrdefprogramnode).  
  
You add the program (your own or Jeeves standard program) that has the required window as the top window. You must also define the 1toMany connection (1toM) to your added node. If there is no connection all rows will be loaded in the list window when you go down into your own added node.  
  
Keep in mind that FromTable\_1toM\_ToTable is always ToTable\_Mto1\_FromTable.  
  
The connection can be an existing Jeeves connection (these are stored in the application directory cxx/) or your own defined many-to-one connection from the main table in the added program to the main table in the window where you add the node.  
  
To use your own many-to-one connection you enter the name of the connection as UpperTable\_1toM\_LowerTable. Jeeves will then search for the many-to-one connection from LowerTable to UpperTable, and inverts it and uses it as a one-to-many connection.  
  
Note! Avoid restrictions in the database if possible. They can cause problems during upgrades. Define any restrictions in usrdefconstraints instead.  
  
Example of a table created with restrictions in the database:

```
create table q_Sublines2Item (  
  ForetagKod smallint default 0,  
  ArtNr varchar(30),  
  RowNo integer default 0,  
  ArtBeskr varchar(30) default 'Wheel',  
  constraint q_Sublines2Item_PK primary key ( ArtNr, RowNo, ForetagKod )
)
alter table q_Sublines2Item add constraint q_Sublines2Item_2_ar foreign key ( ForetagKod, ArtNr ) references ar ( ForetagKod, ArtNr )  --drop table q_Sublines2Item  --execute Jeeves_Load_CXX_From_UsrDefConnections 0,'xx',0,'ar_1tom_q_Sublines2Item' --  check result
```

  
  
Define your own connection in Own, program nodes, connections (UsrDefNodeConnections).  
  

![NULL](981_UsrDefAddedNodes.gif)

User defined program connection.  
  
Here you can add own program connections created in Own program nodes, connections (UsrDefNodeConnections).  
  

### 7.2 **Usr def node connections** [(Program: usrdefnodeconnections)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_usrdefnodeconnections.HTM)

Definition of user defined node connections. You access the program by right-clicking in the Usr def pgm connection field (UsrDefConnection) in the form for definition of own nodes.  
  
You define your own connections in the embedded list window (table: UsrDefNodeConnectionRows). When doing so you can enter different operators such as from to, assign, invert assign etc: "=, :=, >, <, =:, >=, <>".  
  
You can also define connections using user functions.

9 Own calculated columns (dynamic terms)
----------------------------------------

Use the program below to add any own calculated columns (dynamic terms).  

### 9.1 **Own computed columns (dynamic terms)** [(Program: UsrDefCompcols)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_UsrDefCompcols.HTM)

Definition of own defined, computed columns (dynamic terms). The terms can then be added to the table and then to the form. These are columns that are created based on other columns in the same table in the database. Example:  
  
There are fields on the item balance record for inventory balance and order point. You can create your own column which is inventory balance - order point and then obtain a calculated value (computed column) which you can display or use when searching.  
  
Your own column can consist of merged texts (e.g. ZIP/Post code and postal address) or date calculations (e.g. number of calendar days before the order will be delivered).

10 Managing own modifications
-----------------------------

This section describes how to store own modifications (procedures, triggers, views, database functions and subtags) in the database in order to be able to update the database after upgrading or installing fixes, document own modifications and make modifications available as own app components.  
  
In short, you:  
  
1) Create the object in the database.  
  
2) Add the object in the Added/Modified objects program (UsrDefModSQLObject) with the correct type:  
 Store own objects - type ADD  
 Objects to be replaced - type REPLACE  
 Own code within standard objects must be inside location tags - sub tags - type MERGE  
  
3) Press Import modifications fr DB.   
  
Example of a sub tag inside location tags in the standard view "arla" in the database:  

![NULL](981_sub_tags.gif)

  
 Location tags alway come in pairs. Example:  

![NULL](981_loc_tags.gif)
  
  
Sub tags just have one start tag. Example:  

![NULL](981_sub_tag_in_loc_tag.gif)

### **10.1 Templates**

You will find templates for stored procedures, views, functions and table functions in Jeeves file directory, under \spr\q\_templates.  

### **10.2 Overview of programs/tables involved**

Use the program described below to manage own development. The graphic below illustrates the tables that are involved.  

![NULL](981_overview_tables.gif)

### 10.3 **Added/modified objects** [(Program: usrdefmodsqlobject)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_usrdefmodsqlobject.HTM)

Program for management of own modifications of procedures, triggers, views, database functions etc. The program includes functions for putting aside own or modified objects in Jeeves tables and then reloading them after upgrading or installing service packs or fixes, also for importing modifications to other databases.  
  
If you upgrade or install a service pack and sub tags (mod type MERGE) have been stored in this program, the installation program will read the sub tag code in the database and load them into this program/table (in case you have forgot). After the installation all sub tags will automatically be installed in the database.   
  
Note! If you install fixes manually or use JvsSqlRun you must install them yourself.  
  
 - The main form shows the objects that have been modified and imported from the database into tables in the database.  
  
 - If only a part of the object has been modified the embedded list shows the modification location tags and any own sub tags. In underlying program nodes you can see the code for each sub tag.  
  
Note also that tag names must be unique. For further information about tags and sub tags, see the program help for Tags in added/modified objects (UsrDefModSQLObject\_Tag).  
  
Create new records by entering the name of the modification and the type, and then pressing the import button. The object code and sub tag code can be edited here, but we recommend that you edit your objects in the database and import them. The edit field can be used for own documentation of the modification.  
  
There are underlying program nodes to access the tables for source history on the different levels, as well as the original code.

![NULL](981_usrdefmodsqlobject.gif)

![NULL](981_usrdefmodsqlobject_tag.gif)

#### Relevant/important field(s)/button(s):

##### **Object name** [(Field:: DB\_Object\_Name)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_DB_Object_Name.HTM)

Name of database object as defined in the Added/modified objects program (usrdefmodsqlobject).  
  
Using sub tag names, you can connect sub tags in different objects when defining an app.  
  

##### **Type of mod (R/M/A)** [(Field:: UsrDefMod\_type\_SQLObject)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_UsrDefMod_type_SQLObject.HTM)

Type of modification:  
  
 REPLACE - replace existing object  
 MERGE - merge modification within tags with existing object, use for sub tags

See the help for the function buttons in the Added/modified objects program (usrdefmodsqlobject) for further information.  
  

##### **Ansi\_padding** [(Field:: App\_Ansi\_Padding)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_App_Ansi_Padding.HTM)

Setting used in Jeeves packaged solutions to control how database objects should be compiled when importing packages.  
  
If checked (true) ANSI\_PADDING is treated as ON when importing.  
  

##### **Ansi\_nulls** [(Field:: App\_Ansi\_Nulls)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_App_Ansi_Nulls.HTM)

Setting used in Jeeves packaged solutions to control how database objects should be compiled when importing packages.  
  
If checked (true) ANSI\_NULLS is treated as ON when importing.  
  

##### **Ansi\_warnings** [(Field:: App\_Ansi\_Warnings)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_App_Ansi_Warnings.HTM)

Setting used in Jeeves packaged solutions to control how database objects should be compiled when importing packages.  
  
If checked (true) ANSI\_WARNINGS is treated as ON when importing.  
  

##### **Concat\_null\_yields\_null** [(Field:: App\_Concat\_Null\_Yields\_Null)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_App_Concat_Null_Yields_Null.HTM)

Setting used in Jeeves packaged solutions to control how database objects should be compiled when importing packages.  
  
If checked (true) CONCAT\_NULL\_YIELDS\_NULL is treated as ON when importing.  
  

##### **Quoted\_identifier** [(Field:: App\_Quoted\_Identifier)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_App_Quoted_Identifier.HTM)

Setting used in Jeeves packaged solutions to control how database objects should be compiled when importing packages.  
  
If checked (true) QUOTED\_IDENTIFIER is treated as ON when importing.  
  

##### **Arithabort** [(Field:: App\_Arithabort)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_App_Arithabort.HTM)

Setting used in Jeeves packaged solutions to control how database objects should be compiled when importing packages.  
  
If checked (true) ARITHABORT is treated as ON when importing.  
  

##### **Numeric\_roundabort** [(Field:: App\_Numeric\_Roundabort)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_App_Numeric_Roundabort.HTM)

Setting used in Jeeves packaged solutions to control how database objects should be compiled when importing packages.  
  
If checked (true) NUMERIC\_ABORT is treated as ON when importing.  
  

### Button(s) and/or computed field(s):

#### **Import modifications fr DB** [(Button/field: PB\_Fetch\_UsrMod\_From\_DB)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_PB_Fetch_UsrMod_From_DB.HTM)

Function for importing modified objects from the database into tables in the database, for example before upgrading or installing service packs,  
- if modification type ADD or REPLACE, the whole object(s)  
- if modification type MERGE, code within modification tags.  
  
Use the Upd DB with modifications button (PB\_Upd\_DB\_with\_UsrMod) to put them back again after upgrading/installation, or the Export modifications fr DB->FILE button (PB\_Export\_UsrMod\_From\_DB) if you want to import them into another database.  
  

#### **Update DB with modifications** [(Button/field: PB\_Upd\_DB\_with\_UsrMod)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_PB_Upd_DB_with_UsrMod.HTM)

Function for updating the database with own modifications, for example after upgrading or installing service packs or fixes,  
 - if modification type ADD or REPLACE, the whole object  
 - if modification type MERGE, code within modification tags.  
  
You import them from the database into tables with the Import modifications fr DB button (PB\_Fetch\_UsrMod\_From\_DB) before upgrading or installing service packs.  
  

#### **Export modifications fr DB->FILE** [(Button/field: PB\_Export\_UsrMod\_From\_DB)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_PB_Export_UsrMod_From_DB.HTM)

Function for exporting own modifications from the database to file. First you must import them from the database into tables with the Import modifications fr DB button (PB\_Fetch\_UsrMod\_From\_DB) before you can use this function.  
  
A script file is created containing the changed or added code of the object, which can be used to install the modificationsl in another database.  
  

#### **Import all changes from DB** [(Button/field: PB\_Import\_From\_Db\_UsrMod)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_PB_Import_From_Db_UsrMod.HTM)

Function for initiating SQL object browsing through Jeeves procedures and trigger codes for code modifications between modification tags.  
  
When you click this button, the following message is displayed, This button will initiate a process to import all modifications for all database objects. Are you sure you want to proceed? OK. If you click OK, the system begins browsing through Jeeves procedures and trigger codes for code modifications according to Jeeves standard routines.   
  
If there is a code part not entered in the Added/modified objects or Tags in added/modified objects (usrdefmodsqlobject/usrdefmodsqlobject\_tag) tables, the name of the SQL Object (procedure/trigger) that has code modifications is automatically entered in these tables.  
  

### 10.4 **Tags in added/modified objects** [(Program: usrdefmodsqlobject\_tag)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_usrdefmodsqlobject_tag.HTM)

A modification location tag is a place marker for own code inserted into Jeeves' standard code.   
  
Location tags exist in all triggers, and in all procedures. Jeeves Information Systems will add new tags upon request to the source of any procedure, trigger, view and database function, as long as it is in a logical place and of use for more than one customer. There are some tags in procedures created in earlier versions too (for example in oh\_create\_fh and the Item data/inventory location view (arla)). Search for "UsrDef\_Mod\_" (suitably after prefixed characters) to find them.  
  
There are always two modification location tags; one to mark the beginning of the modification and one to mark the end.   
  
 Sub tags   
 -----------  
A sub tag is a place marker that can be used to separate different modifications within the same tag, for example for different countries and customers.  
  
Use the sub tag name to connect related modifications in different objects, for example all modifications made by your company for a certain customer. By doing so, you can export them together via Jeeves' Apps builder.  
  
Note! Tag names must be unique. See Jeeves' extended name convention.  
  
There is only one sub tag to mark the beginning of the modification in question. The name is suffixed with the order of priority among the sub tags. It is also marked with one asterisk (\*) if the code has been imported from the database and two (\*\*) if it has been updated in the database.

#### Relevant/important field(s)/button(s):

##### **Object name** [(Field:: db\_object\_name)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_db_object_name.HTM)

Name of database object as defined in the Added/modified objects program (usrdefmodsqlobject).  
  
Using sub tag names, you can connect sub tags in different objects when defining an app.  
  

##### **Tag in DB object** [(Field:: db\_object\_tagname)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_db_object_tagname.HTM)

Location tag for own code in a standard trigger, procedure etc.  
  

##### **Name of sub tag** [(Field:: db\_sub\_tagname)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_db_sub_tagname.HTM)

Name of a sub tag used in one or several triggers or procedures.  
  

##### **Tag seq in DB object** [(Field:: db\_object\_tagsequence)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_db_object_tagsequence.HTM)

Sequence number for location tag in database object, used if there are several tags within the same object.  
  

##### **Sub tag seq in tag** [(Field:: db\_sub\_tagsequence)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_db_sub_tagsequence.HTM)

Sequence number for location subtag in database object, used to separate different modifications within the same tag, for example for different countries and customers.  
  

##### **Sub tag priority in tag** [(Field:: db\_sub\_tagpriority)](ms-its:Terms_SE.chm::/ted_db_sub_tagpriority.HTM)

Priority of location subtag in database object, used to prioritize different modifications within the same tag, for example for different countries or customers. The lower the number, the higher the priority.


  

**This chapter is only provided in English.**

---------------------------------------

### 1.1 **Tabeller fr kopiering** [(Program: xfil)](ms-its:Programs_SE.chm::/pgm_xfil.HTM)

I tidigare versioner av Jeeves ERP markerade funktionen fr kopiering av data till nyskapade fretag ven transaktionstabeller fr kopiering. Tanken var att kunna skapa olika typer av fretag, till exempel test- och utbildningsfretag, som innehller transaktioner fr tester och utbildning.  
  
Eftersom konsulter normalt sett inte anvnder funktionaliteten p det hr sttet, har vi ndrat tabelldefinitionen s att transaktionstabellerna inte lngre markeras fr kopiering. Tabelldefinitionen Tabeller fr kopiering (xfil) markerar nu endast basdatatabeller och systemdatatabeller.
